title: Compliance and Privacy Partner
description:
Overview

This position oversees all ongoing activities related to the development, implementation and maintenance of Logan Health’s compliance and privacy programs.

Our Mission : Quality, compassionate care for all.

Our Vision : Reimagine health care through connection, service and innovation.

Our Core Values : Be Kind | Trust and Be Trusted | Work Together | Strive for Excellence.

Compliance and Privacy Partner

Make a difference with Logan Health. At Logan Health, compliance and privacy are not just about policies. They are about people, trust, and living out our values every day. We are seeking a Compliance and Privacy Partner who wants to be part of a collaborative team that supports leaders, protects patients, and strengthens the community we serve.

This is an opportunity to grow in a supportive environment, contribute to meaningful projects, and work with colleagues who value integrity, respect, and teamwork.

What You’ll Do

  • Support leaders and team members across the organization by advancing compliance and privacy program.
  • Contribute to projects that involve risk assessments, monitoring, and auditing, and utilizing data driven decision making.
  • Provide clear, practical supportive guidance on compliance and privacy regulations.
  • Work with a collaborative team that shares knowledge, balances priorities, and supports each other’s growth.
  • Contribute to education, training, and resources that strengthen a learning culture of compliance and privacy practices.
  • Stay up to date on state and federal regulations and bring that knowledge into daily practice applying them to real-world situations.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who brings strong character, professionalism, and curiosity to their work. If you are collaborative, approachable, and motivated to learn, you will thrive here.

Preferred background and skills include:

  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • Experience leading projects and working with diverse teams.
  • Previous compliance or privacy experience, ideally in healthcare, but not required. Skills gained in industries like banking, insurance, aviation, technology, or government can also be a strong fit.
  • Interest in obtaining a professional compliance or privacy certification, with support to achieve it within two years of qualifying for certification.

Why Join Us

You will be part of a close-knit team that values collaboration, knowledge sharing, and respect. Each team member brings unique strengths, and together we build solutions that serve our patients, colleagues, and community. At Logan Health, we focus on integrity, building a culture of learning, and care for people. We believe in supporting each other’s professional growth, creating a place where your contributions matter and are valued.

Shift: Day Shift - Variable Hours (United States of America)

Schedule: Logan Health operates 24 hours per day, seven days per week. Schedules are set to accommodate the requirements of the position and the needs of the organization and may be adjusted as needed.

Notice of Pre-Employment Screening Requirements

If you receive a job offer, please note all offers are contingent upon passing a pre-employment screening, which includes:

  • Criminal background check
  • Reference checks
  • Drug Screening
  • Health and Immunizations Screening
  • Physical Demand Review/Screening

Equal Opportunity Employer

Logan Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE/AA/M-F/Vet/Disability). We encourage all qualified individuals to apply for employment. We do not discriminate against any applicant or employee based on protected veteran status, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability or any other basis protected by applicable law. If you require accommodation to complete the application, testing or interview process, please notify Human Resources.

description:
Overview

JOB TITLE: Head of Engineering
LOCATION: Remote
DURATION: Permanent
RATE RANGE: 200k + Early stage equity

POSITION SUMMARY:

You’ll help design and build the systems that ingest fragmented financial data, reconcile it, and expose it through reliable, testable interfaces. You’ll work across the stack to solve complex, data-heavy problems with high accuracy requirements and real-world impact. This role blends hands-on technical execution with technical leadership and mentorship as we scale.

Responsibilities

  • Scalable services to ingest and standardize data from documents, ERPs, and portals
  • Internal APIs and interfaces that power reconciliation, reporting, and automation
  • Infrastructure optimized for observability, reliability, and deployment simplicity
  • Patterns for integrating machine learning and generative AI features into production systems
  • A technical foundation that scales with customer usage and product complexity

Qualifications

  • 8-10 years of experience working in high-quality engineering environments; startup experience is a plus.
  • Thrives in fast-changing, ambiguous environments - excited to take ownership, figure things out and build from zero with speed and autonomy.
  • Track record of building reliable, production-grade systems that handle real-world data (structured and unstructured)
  • Proficiency in Python, TypeScript, or similar languages; comfort with AWS/GCP
  • Familiarity with transactional systems, billing tools, or reconciliation workflows
  • High ownership mindset, strong communication skills, and a bias for action
  • Interest in helping recruit and mentor future engineers as the team grows
  • Bonus: Experience working on document parsing, financial systems, or workflow optimization

Benefits

Benefits summary: Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate or annual salary only, unless otherwise stated. In addition to base compensation, full-time roles are eligible for Medical, Dental, Vision, Commuter and 401K benefits with company matching.

title: Chief Medical Officer
description:
Overview

The Chief Medical Officer will be responsible for overseeing all clinical aspects of optometric care and ensures the alignment of services with the organization’s mission, values, and community health objectives. Lead the optometry team in establishing performance expectations and mechanisms for delivering and monitoring high-quality, accessible eye care to patient population. Ensures clinical services align with the organization’s strategic goals, compliance requirements, and community-focused mission. The role will serve on the Global Executive Team reporting to the CEO.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee clinical operations across all locations, ensuring efficient workflow and high-quality care delivery
  • Develop and maintain clinical protocols, scope-of-practice standards, and care pathways across the network
  • Ensure timely and appropriate scheduling, documentation, and patient follow-up procedures
  • Collaborate with peers for the overall strategic planning to ensure alignment with broader organization goals and improve outcomes
  • Foster alignment and unity of all employed and VSP Vision affiliated clinical professionals to centralize clinical expertise and guidance, and ensure compliance
  • Implement and oversee quality assurance and patient safety program
  • Ensure compliance with healthcare regulations including HIPAA, OSHA, state licensure requirements, and company-specific standards
  • Analyze patient outcomes, clinical performance metrics, and satisfaction data to identify improvement opportunities
  • Responsible for the long-term strategy for expanding services, partnerships, and innovations in care delivery
  • Oversee integration of tele-optometry, vision rehabilitation, or low vision services as appropriate
  • Act as the clinical spokesperson for the VSP Vision Enterprise

Job Specifications

  • Doctor of Optometry (OD)
  • Active state optometry license
  • Minimum of 10 years of clinical experience in optometry with clear progression to executive/senior leadership roles, leading and motivating a cross-functional interdisciplinary team to achieve strategic goals
  • Experience working in a corporate executive role with business skills and accountabilities
  • Strong understanding of vision care, healthcare regulations, and insurance practices
  • Experience in population health and/or disease management and relationship between eyecare and overall systemic health issues
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate effectively at an executive level and engage and inspire diverse stakeholders
  • Proven track record in strategic planning, quality improvement, and program development
  • Ability to be a thought leader internally and externally representing clinical and non-clinical environments
  • Ability to build strong and sustainable trusting relationships and the capability to interact within all levels of the organization, internally and externally
  • Ability to deal with highly confidential information and act as a liaison between the business leader and other constituencies, both internal and external

Preferred Skills

  • MBA highly desirable

title: Business Development Partner - Customer Solutions Midwest - Remote
description:
Job Summary

The Business Development Partner - Customer Solutions (reporting to VP Solutions Operations) will support business leaders in an assigned geography (market) to create and nurture market plans, identifying key customers, influencers, and projects to drive CRH awareness and opportunities in their assigned market, pushing the organization to look beyond current project scopes to find opportunities to create customer value. This individual will act as the hub for all CRH-focused commercial activities.

Job Location

This is a remote position and may be based out any of the following states: Wisconsin, Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Ohio or Michigan.

Job Responsibilities

  • Working with the business leaders in a particular geography and the market team to develop a targeted market-planned approach for CRH-focused opportunities. This includes customers, influencers, and projects.
  • Support the market teams on project managing pipeline maturity, nurturing opportunities to win/lost, and recording activity in Salesforce.com.
  • Provide coaching and mentoring to market teams, emphasizing customer-connected selling methodologies, collaboration, and addressing customer pain points.
  • Support new market team launches within assigned geography, including helping leadership stand up and assimilate a cross-platform team and adopt a new selling strategy.
  • Engage with local market leaders to identify and qualify CRH-focused opportunities, searching for projects across multiple lines of business with local market knowledge of capabilities.
  • Support the Monthly Business Review through Salesforce trackers and dashboards.
  • Collaborate with other Solutions Region Managers to facilitate best practices and develop game plans.
  • Provide input to optimize commercial playbooks.
  • Drive playbook utilization and value selling tools across assigned market teams.
  • Build a CRH network and work across the organization to identify market drivers and promote awareness of CRH capabilities.
  • Build a market network to help connect the market team to developers, specifiers, and engineers to foster awareness and opportunities around the full breadth of CRH capabilities.
  • Travel 25-30%.
  • Other duties as directed by management.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or a related field of study is preferred.
  • Minimum ten (10) years of progressive business experience, mixture of operational and commercial experience strongly preferred. Commercial Aptitude is critical.
  • Experience in building materials, construction or manufacturing sectors preferred.
  • Ability to solve complex problems by identification of most impactful actions and prioritizing efforts in addressing them.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and complexity, able to adapt rapidly.
  • Adept with Salesforce Software.
  • Good communicator- writes well using clear and concise language.
  • Personable, able to connect and collaborate with others.
  • Highly strategic and comfortable with ambiguity.

Compensation

  • Basepay is $160,000-180,000 plus bonus

What CRH Offers You

  • Highly competitive base pay
  • Comprehensive medical, dental and disability benefits programs
  • Group retirement savings program
  • Health and wellness programs
  • An inclusive culture that values opportunity for growth, development, and internal promotion

About CRH

CRH has a long and proud heritage. We are a collection of hundreds of family businesses, regional companies and large enterprises that together form the CRH family. CRH operates in a decentralized, diversified structure that allows you to work in a small company environment while having the career opportunities of a large international organization.

Overview

At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We’re looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world. Lilly Catalyze360, a Division of Lilly Research Laboratories, is a comprehensive approach to enabling the early-stage biotech ecosystem, agnostic of the therapeutic area. There are four pillars: Lilly Gateway Labs, ExploR&D, Lilly Ventures and Lilly TuneLab. Learn more about Catalyze360 at:

Lilly Gateway Labs links Lilly to an entrepreneurial community fostering innovation. It provides biotech companies direct access to Lilly scientists and expertise, opportunities to collaborate on projects of mutual interest, and learning forums with Lilly experts and partners, with potential for financial investment from Lilly or venture funds. Learn more at:

ExploR&D is a drug development organization within Catalyze360 focused on catalyzing the biotechnology ecosystem. It advances investigational medicines for external sponsors with speed and efficiency and supports programs across North America, Europe, and Asia. Learn more at:

Lilly Ventures maintains relationships with life science-focused funds to gain access to emerging science, with three portfolios (Therapeutics, Technology, and Impact) and investment tools including fund partnerships and direct investments.

Lilly TuneLab provides access to AI/ML tools leveraging Lilly's drug discovery models.

Position

The successful candidate for the Senior Director, Counsel, Legal TLM - Catalyze360 (Transactions) will be a core member of Lilly’s legal team, helping drive the company’s mission and serving as a trusted advisor and leader to the Catalyze360 team. The role offers the opportunity to contribute immediately to Lilly’s growth and success. We seek a proven leader who is motivated, proactive, thrives in ambiguity, self-starting, and enjoys challenges.

Primary Responsibilities

This position provides legal support for the Lilly Gateway Labs and ExploR&D capabilities of Catalyze360 and will have the following responsibilities:

  • Lead the structuring, drafting, negotiating and counseling on transactions (including licenses and collaborations, R&D services, equity investments, divestitures and other transactions).
  • Serve as both a legal and business partner in structuring and implementing new Catalyze360 offerings and transaction models.
  • Develop agreement templates and playbooks and lead training for the Catalyze360 team.
  • Identify and resolve critical legal and business issues throughout the lifecycle of Catalyze360 agreements, including post-transaction alliance management support.
  • Partner with the Catalyze360 team and other internal stakeholders to ensure strategic alignment and support the growth of the Catalyze360 organization.
  • Exercise excellent judgment to influence and drive decision-making.
  • Cultivate and contribute to the development of a high-performance transactions legal team and a collaborative culture with colleagues in the legal department and other key functions.
  • Demonstrate a service-oriented approach to advising internal client groups.
  • Serve as a recognized source of innovative ideas in complex areas of law, business, or technology with respect to transactional matters.

Basic Requirements

  • J.D. from an ABA-accredited law school.
  • Admitted to the bar in at least one state.
  • Minimum of six (6) years of legal experience drafting, reviewing and negotiating sophisticated transactions in either a law firm or in-house, or a combination of both.
  • Significant experience drafting and negotiating complex transaction agreements in the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry (including CRO and CDMO agreements).
  • Authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Lilly will not sponsor work authorization or visas for this role.

Additional Skills/Preferences

  • Ability to proactively identify opportunities for creative and innovative solutions to transactional issues and process improvements.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills and business judgment with the ability to influence others.
  • Strong interpersonal skills to manage internal client expectations and collaborate in cross-functional teams within a matrix environment.
  • Professional demeanor with the gravitas to lead and influence a seasoned business team.
  • Fast, nimble, and able to pivot between audiences to provide timely legal and business advice.
  • Team-oriented, collaborative, and capable of working independently.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple projects with priorities and deadlines.
  • Analytical and strategic with the ability to devise creative solutions to drive toward recommendations and closure.
  • Impeccable integrity and ability to handle confidential matters with discretion.
  • Ability to lead outside counsel selection and oversee legal costs.

title: Interim Head of Revenue Operations
description:
Overview

Redox is on a mission to accelerate healthcare’s transformation with useful data. The Redox Engine is a flexible interoperability platform that connects and powers real-time healthcare data exchange. With one connection, data can be orchestrated across a growing network of 11,000+ systems and organizations, including 90+ electronic health record systems (EHRs). Redox processes over 1.6 billion messages per month across health tech vendors, providers, payers, EHRs, and life sciences customers.

Opportunity & Impact

We are seeking an interim Head of Revenue Operations to assist with designing, implementing, and operationalizing the next phase of our GTM engine while we evaluate long-term leadership needs. You will own execution and team development, and you will partner closely with the Chief of Staff, SVP Customer Success, SVP Sales, CFO, and other executive stakeholders.

Job Responsibilities

  • Revenue Strategy & Planning: Execute the Revenue Operations strategy, working cross-functionally to align processes, systems, and resourcing with company growth goals. Lead annual and quarterly planning cycles, including quota design, territory planning, and scenario modeling. Oversee the full variable compensation process, from plan design through payout administration, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and alignment with company objectives.
  • Forecasting, Pipeline & Performance Insights: Drive forecasting methodology and pipeline governance, partnering with Sales, Customer Success, and Finance to improve accuracy and predictability. Define, track, and report on KPIs across the entire revenue funnel (prospect → booking → expansion/renewal). Deliver executive dashboards and performance reporting that provide actionable insights and support data-driven decision-making.
  • Process, Systems & Tools Optimization: Standardize lead-to-cash workflows and strengthen cross-functional handoffs across the customer lifecycle. Maintain Salesforce health and oversee GTM system integrations, while recommending automation and AI-driven solutions to reduce manual effort and improve scalability. Support analysis of GTM tech stack, provide recommendations, and potentially execute improvements. Manage GTM System Vendor relationships and renewals.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership & Program Management: Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Finance, and Product to ensure a unified revenue architecture that enables predictable growth. Lead strategic, cross-functional initiatives with clear accountability, timelines, and communication to stakeholders. Partner with the Chief of Staff and the Executive team to support ad hoc analyses and materials for strategic decision-making or Board of Directors discussions.
  • Team Leadership & Development: Mentor, coach, and onboard Revenue Operations team members. Build scalable processes, foster a culture of accountability, and enable the team to support evolving business needs.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 10+ years of Senior Revenue Operations leadership or GTM Strategy experience, including 5+ years of people management, ideally in healthcare technology SaaS.
  • Track record leading full-time fractional or interim RevOps engagements for high-growth companies.
  • Deep CRM and marketing automation expertise, including working with both CPQ and Salesforce Rev Cloud is required.
  • Strong financial acumen and the ability to translate complex data into executive-level strategy.
  • Comfortable working in a fully remote, rapidly scaling organization.

Engagement Details

  • Full-time contract (approx. 40 hrs/week) for 3–6 months, with potential extension.
  • Must be available during normal business hours for executive meetings and cross-functional collaboration.

Who We Are

At MonetizeMore, we use AI and data to revolutionize how the advertising industry combats Invalid Traffic (IVT) and fraud. Our flagship product, Traffic Cop, is a premium solution designed to protect ad-monetized publishers and ad tech vendors from fraudulent activity. For over 15 years, our fully remote team of 100+ professionals has been driven by four core pillars: Integrity, Collaboration, Enterprising, and Kaizen. We are culture-centric, results-driven, and obsessed with building impactful, data-powered solutions.

What It’s Like Working Here

  • Fail Fast, Learn Faster: Mistakes are data. We improve from them.
  • Follow Through: We do what we say—big or small.

Your Role: Head of Sales

As our Head of Sales, you’ll be responsible for defining, leading, and executing MonetizeMore’s global sales strategy. This is a high-impact leadership role for a strategic, hands-on sales expert who can build and scale a revenue engine across international markets, with a focus on high-value enterprise clients in the ad-tech space.

What You’ll Do

  • Own & Lead the Sales Function: Drive the entire sales cycle from strategy to execution—from lead generation to contract close.
  • Set the Sales Vision: Define and execute MonetizeMore’s go-to-market strategy in collaboration with the Executive Team.
  • Drive Strategic Revenue: Target and close deals with Publishers, have existing relationships and broad-based understanding around the needs of DSPs, SSPs, GCPPs, MCMs, exchanges to drive partner-led sales for Traffic Cop across LATAM.
  • Build & Scale the Sales Team: Hire, coach, and manage high-performing sales talent, building a metrics-driven sales org.
  • Act as a Player-Coach: Stay hands-on in high-stakes sales conversations and negotiations while coaching others to success.
  • Present & Educate: Deliver compelling product pitches and demos tailored to client challenges and verticals.
  • Refine the Value Proposition: Work with Marketing and Product to sharpen our messaging and positioning in a competitive market.
  • Optimize Pipeline & Forecasting: Maintain an accurate sales pipeline, forecast revenue, and hit aggressive growth targets.
  • Establish Strategic Partnerships: Identify and onboard channel partners to amplify our reach and strengthen joint go-to-market efforts.
  • Inform Product & GTM Strategy: Relay market intelligence and customer feedback to help shape our product roadmap and growth initiatives.
  • Sell with AI in Mind: Understand and articulate how our AI-powered Traffic Cop solves complex fraud and IVT issues in digital advertising—positioning its technological edge as a major differentiator in the market.

Who You Are

  • Proven Sales Leader: 7–10 years of experience in SaaS, cybersecurity, or ad-tech sales, with a minimum of 3 years in a leadership role.
  • AI Fluent: Understands AI and machine learning in digital advertising, fraud detection, or cybersecurity and can translate technical concepts into business value for enterprise clients.
  • Ad-Tech Fluent: Deep understanding of the ad-tech ecosystem—including publishers, DSPs, SSPs, and exchanges.
  • Strategic & Analytical: Uses data to inform decisions and isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo.
  • Exceptional Communicator: Clear, persuasive, and confident in high-level discussions with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Global Operator: Experience working across multiple time zones and regions, especially LATAM.
  • Self-Motivated & Results-Oriented: Takes initiative, thrives in ambiguity, and is relentless in pursuit of goals.
  • Builder & Innovator: Comfortable in startup or scale-up environments with a mindset for continuous improvement.

Why Join Us

  • 100% remote with flexible work hours.
  • Work with a highly driven, globally distributed team.
  • Be part of a fast-growing company solving meaningful problems in the ad-tech industry.
  • Opportunity to shape the sales function and leadership path in a mission-driven, data-powered company.

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

A day in the life:

As a Landing Page Strategist, you’ll play a critical role in executing and optimizing high-performing landing pages that drive real business results across lead generation, paid media, and eCommerce campaigns.You’ll work closely with senior strategists, paid media teams, lifecycle marketers, account managers, and creatives to support the day-to-day management of our clients’ landing page programs. This includes strategic planning, copywriting, QA, stakeholder communication, A/B testing, reporting, and ongoing optimization.This is a client-facing, detail-oriented role ideal for someone with a passion for conversion strategy, digital marketing, and performance design. You’ll gain deep hands-on experience across the entire landing page lifecycle while helping execute and grow one of our most impactful service lines.

Responsibilities:

Client Execution & Project Management

  • Own the execution of landing page deliverables across strategy, copywriting, design feedback, development handoff, QA, and launch
  • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for internal teams and assist with client communication when needed
  • Translate paid media strategy and campaign briefs into high-converting landing page experiences
  • Work within structured workflows and project management tools (e.g., Asana) to track deliverables and meet timelines
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Paid Media, Lifecycle, Creative, and Development teams to align messaging, offers, and user experience
  • Assist in developing and refining landing page strategies that align with funnel stages and campaign goals
  • Conduct CRO audits, scroll map/click map reviews, and post-launch performance analysis to surface insights and optimizations
  • Support A/B testing strategy creation, execution, and reporting
  • Apply best practices in messaging hierarchy, user experience, and mobile-first design
  • Maintain knowledge of platform and ad network guidelines (Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, etc.)

Content & QA Support

  • Draft or refine landing page copy tailored to target personas, offers, and funnel stage
  • Review landing pages for accuracy, responsiveness, and proper integration with forms, calendars, pixels, and CRMs
  • Work with developers and creative teams to ensure pages meet quality standards prior to launch
  • Work alongside the Managing Director to operationalize best practices and document repeatable workflows
  • Help maintain and improve internal tools such as audit templates, performance trackers, and testing roadmaps
  • Contribute to ongoing training and resource development for internal teams and freelancers
  • Proactively identify areas for improvement across design, process, messaging, or reporting

Role Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in CRO or running Landing Page projects (agency experience preferred)..
  • Portfolio of work examples with proven results
  • Experience working with Landing Page & CRM platforms: Unbounce, Hubspot, Marketo, etc
  • Experience working with design platforms like Figma
  • Experience with user behavior tools like Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar, etc

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Implement AI-driven automation 50%+ of landing page workflows.
  • On-time delivery of landing page milestones (strategy, copy, QA, launch)
  • Conversion rate performance vs. benchmark or prior page
  • Number of launched landing pages per month
  • Client satisfaction and internal team feedback
  • A/B testing velocity and learnings logged

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Execute Flawlessly Across the Landing Page Lifecycle – Deliver end-to-end execution across strategy, copy, QA, and launch
  • Drive Conversion-Focused Results – Apply best practices and insights to improve performance and meet client goals
  • Collaborate Across Teams – Serve as the operational glue between Paid, Lifecycle, Creative, and Dev teams
  • Grow Through Process and Learning – Support the growth of the landing page program through repeatable systems and continuous improvement

Humana is a publicly traded, Fortune 50 healthcare company with a legacy of innovation, evolving from skilled nursing and hospitals to one of the largest health benefits providers in the US. At the core of this evolution is Humana’s Insurance Segment, which provides Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and other health plans to millions. By integrating insurance with care delivery through CenterWell, Humana is improving healthcare access, coordination, and affordability for its members.

Humana’s Insurance Segment Strategy team plays a pivotal role in defining the future of Humana’s Medicare and Medicaid businesses, which generate the majority of the company’s total revenue and earnings. Comprised of experienced professionals from top-tier consulting firms and leading healthcare organizations, the team works closely with senior leaders across the enterprise to drive high-profile strategy projects that address the business’s most complex challenges and biggest opportunities.

We’re not just another recruiting firm - we focus on placing candidates with exceptional US and EU founders who prioritize the long-term success of their team members. We also provide retention bonuses at 3, 6, 9, and 12 months, as well as community-driven benefits like an annual retreat.

About the Company

The Partner Company offers a unique blend of shuffleboard fun, tropical vibes, and events in Brooklyn and Chicago. They’re looking to grow their digital presence with engaging, location-specific content and targeted advertising to drive foot traffic, event attendance, and brand loyalty.

Role Overview

As a Marketing Strategist, you’ll drive the online presence of the Partner's Company at Brooklyn and Chicago locations through engaging social media content and targeted advertising. You'll own content strategy and community management across Instagram and TikTok, run Google Ads campaigns, and track performance to inform future creative and strategic decisions. This is a high-impact role for someone who is equal parts creative and analytical, thrives in fast-paced environments, and understands what drives engagement in the hospitality and lifestyle space.

Key Responsibilities

Social Media Management

  • Develop and execute monthly content calendars tailored to each venue’s unique personality and audience.
  • Collaborate remotely with venue managers and staff to coordinate on-site content capture (photos and short-form video).
  • Create content aligned with trending formats, memes, pop culture, and community interests.
  • Manage daily community engagement, responding to comments, DMs, and sharing user-generated content.
  • Maintain brand tone and consistency across all social channels.

Digital Advertising & Analytics

  • Plan, launch, and optimize Google Ads campaigns for events, leagues, and brand awareness.
  • Manage boosted posts and paid campaigns on Instagram and TikTok.
  • Track and report on key performance indicators including reach, engagement, conversions, and ROI.
  • Deliver clear monthly performance reports with actionable insights and recommendations.

Creative Innovation & Brand Growth

  • Propose and test new content series or campaign ideas each quarter.
  • Stay on top of social media trends to keep the brand’s content fresh and relevant.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with internal marketing and event teams to align messaging and objectives.

Requirements

Must-Have:

  • 2–4 years of overall professional experience, with at least 1–2 years directly managing Instagram, TikTok, and Google Ads for hospitality, entertainment, or lifestyle brands.
  • Strong understanding of current social media trends, meme culture, and visual storytelling.
  • Hands-on experience with social media scheduling tools.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to turn data into strategy.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate with remote and in-person teams.
  • Strong time-management skills; able to juggle multiple priorities and locations independently.
  • Portfolio or clear case studies showcasing successful campaigns and measurable results.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Content creation skills (e.g., video editing, basic design using Canva or Adobe Suite).
  • Experience coordinating or working directly with event-based marketing.
  • Familiarity with TikTok’s creator tools and Instagram Reels best practices.
  • Background in hospitality, nightlife, or entertainment environments.
  • Passion for fun, community-focused spaces.

KPIs & Success Metrics

  • Engagement Rate: Improve average likes, comments, shares, and saves across platforms.
  • Follower Growth: Achieve consistent growth on both Instagram and TikTok.
  • Content Output: Publish 2–3 posts per week per platform, plus stories and reels.
  • Community Management: Respond to 100% of messages and comments within 24 business hours.
  • Ad Performance: Meet or exceed industry benchmarks on CTR, conversions, and ROAS.
  • Event Uplift: Demonstrate increased attendance or signups linked to campaigns.
  • Reporting: Deliver clear, strategic performance reports monthly.
  • Innovation: Launch at least one new content series or idea every quarter.

  • Generous PTO: Ample paid time off to rest and recharge

title: Video Editor For Science & Paleontology Youtube Channel
description:
Overview

I'm looking for a video editor who specializes in long-form content. This would be a full-time position to edit videos for a YouTube channel that specializes in educational content (think TierZoo). We need someone who is proficient in editing, able to do simple to moderately complex graphics / animations, and able to adapt their style to match our video’s style.

It is crucial that you have a strong grasp of the English language, as our videos are primarily about paleontology. Being able to understand scientific terminology and doing some research is a must. If paleontology and science in general are personal interests of yours, then this role will be perfect for you.

The process of the job is that we provide you with a script and audio that matches the script, and then it will be your role to find supporting images, videos, and create short motion graphics when applicable. The videos and images will be sourced from studies, documentaries, Wikipedia / Wikimedia, art websites (DeviantArt, ArtStation, etc.), and studies, so being able to Google proficiently is very important. Our video upload schedule is around 1 long-form video a week (between 20–30 minutes in length).

Responsibilities

To qualify for this position you need to be :

  • Experienced video editor (experience with motion graphics and simple 2D animations)
  • Highly proficient in English
  • Proficient in research
  • Fast and diligent learner, always looking to improve and willing to take the time to understand things like scientific concepts in order to best add value to the video
  • Organized and punctual with delivery
  • Able to learn from feedback (I do not want to provide the same feedback every time without change)
  • Not afraid to ask questions
  • Comfortable using whichever professional video editing tools you prefer

This is a position that can grow as the channel(s) grow over time, meaning that this job can evolve and change. (Also, to show me you read this whole thing, put "I like dinosaurs" in your response, along with whatever else you want.) Compensation is per minute edited, with the number depending on time and proficiency.

What you will do

To apply, please reach out and maybe send me the 1 video you’re most proud of that best shows your applicable talents.

Additionally, please answer these few questions in your reach-out :

  • Where are you from?
  • How many hours a week can you commit to this?
  • What was your last video editing experience?

Na SoftExpert, a área de Alianças Estratégicas é o motor que impulsiona nossa expansão global e a entrega de valor inigualável aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos em parceria com líderes de mercado, como KPMG, EY, Seidor e AWS, para desenvolver soluções inovadoras e alcançar novos patamares de negócio. Sua atuação será crucial para impulsionar a venda da nossa suíte, através de um trabalho colaborativo e estratégico.

Main responsibilities

  • Design de Soluções Low-Code: Conceber e desenhar soluções personalizadas, com foco em low-code, utilizando a suíte SoftExpert para atender aos projetos e expectativas de nossos parceiros.

Overview

Help us change lives

Position Overview

The Lead Engineer, Artificial Intelligence is a pivotal role responsible for driving the strategic vision and technical execution of AI platform and MLOps initiatives within the organization. This position emphasizes expertise in Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Large Language Models (LLMs), combined with deep knowledge of model lifecycle operations, observability, and governance. The Lead Engineer will architect and operationalize scalable AI/ML platforms, ensuring solutions are reliable, reproducible, and compliant with organizational and regulatory requirements. Success in this role requires balancing technical depth with leadership—guiding teams, fostering collaboration, and embedding operational excellence across the enterprise.

Essential Duties

Include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Lead the design and execution of AI/ML solutions across the lifecycle, including model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring, with a strong focus on reliability, cost optimization, and compliance.
  • Architect and scale CI/CD and Infrastructure-as-Code pipelines for ML and GenAI workloads, embedding automated testing, governance, and environment promotion practices.
  • Collaborate closely with data scientists, ML engineers, and software engineers to ensure seamless integration of models and services into production systems.
  • Oversee experiment tracking, registry governance, and reproducibility frameworks to ensure traceability, audit readiness, and alignment to quality standards.
  • Partner with platform, data, and security teams to design robust infrastructure for training and inference (real-time and batch/streaming).
  • Implement observability frameworks to detect drift, performance regressions, and cost anomalies, and lead incident response and continuous improvement cycles.
  • Champion responsible AI practices, addressing issues of data privacy, security, and bias while ensuring alignment to regulatory standards and company policies.
  • Coach, support, and provide mentorship for team members.
  • Stay updated on advancements in AI research, MLOps practices, and AI platform technologies to guide initiatives.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning within the team.
  • Uphold company mission and values through accountability, innovation, integrity, quality, and teamwork.
  • Support and comply with the company’s Quality Management System policies and procedures.
  • Maintain regular and reliable attendance.
  • Ability to act with an inclusion mindset and model these behaviors for the organization.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field; or High School Diploma/General Education Degree and 4+ years of relevant experience as outlined in the essential duties in lieu of Bachelor’s Degree.
  • Demonstrated expertise in designing and deploying cutting-edge AI solutions that drive measurable business impact.
  • Demonstrated understanding of ethical considerations in AI systems.
  • 3+ years of project leadership experience including Agile project management, Scaled Agile Frameworks (SAFE).
  • Advanced ability working with machine learning frameworks, programming languages like Python, and cloud platforms.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with expertise in AI/ML techniques.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading enterprise-scale MLOps initiatives.
  • Deep experience with MLflow or equivalent lifecycle platforms (tracking, registry, deployment) and Unity Catalog/feature stores.
  • Expertise in scalable serving patterns (real-time inference, batch/streaming), containerization, and GPU-optimized deployments.
  • Familiarity with GenAI delivery at scale, including Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt governance, and LLM orchestration frameworks.
  • Knowledge of cost optimization strategies for GPU/LLM workloads (e.g., quantization, batching, autoscaling).
  • Experience implementing observability and SLOs for ML/GenAI systems (drift detection, evaluation gates, incident playbooks).
  • Exposure to governance and compliance practices for ML/GenAI systems, including data lineage, access control, and privacy-by-design.

Somos uma instituição que tem a tradição e inovação como pilares. A Santa Casa da Bahia é uma associação beneficente de assistência social, que se propõe ao exercício da caridade e prestação de serviços nas áreas de saúde, ensino e pesquisa, cultura, assistência social e educação, sem subordinação ao Estado ou à Igreja.

A instituição secular, quesempre esteve a serviço do bem da população baiana , tem sua gestão orientada estrategicamente para que colaboradores e voluntários sigam a mesma base filosófica e, com isso, a sociedade possa compreender a personalidade da entidade.

Propósito: Cuidar de pessoas e estimular a dignidade;

Juntos podemos mais

Fazemos bem-feito, sem desperdício e com segurança;

  • Realizar a vigilância ativa das infeções hospitalares, identificando casos, fontes e possíveis surtos.
  • Recolher, analisar e interpretar dados epidemiológicos para identificar padrões e fatores de risco.
  • Desenvolver e manter registos de infeções hospitalares, de acordo com as normas estabelecidas pelo hospital e órgãos de saúde.
  • Elaborar protocolos e procedimentos de prevenção e controle de infeções, incluindo práticas de higiene e esterilização.
  • Capacitar e formar a equipe de saúde sobre medidas de prevenção e controle de infeções.
  • Entre outras atividades inerentes ao cargo.
  • Ensino Superior em Enfermagem;

  • 44 horas semanais- em regime administrativo.

Regime de trabalho:

  • Salário compatível com o mercado
  • Alimentação no local
  • Plano de Saúde

Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Seja bem-vindo (a) ao Portal de Carreiras da Santa Casa da Bahia!

Ficamos felizes pelo seu interesse em participar da nossa equipe de colaboradores, que já soma aproximadamente 5.500 funcionários.

Antes de sabermos mais sobre suas características profissionais, convidamos você a conhecer um pouco da história da Santa Casa da

Bahia, instituição filantrópica que se propõe ao objetivo de ajudar aos mais necessitados.

Foi no ano de 1549, quando Tomé de Sousa ocupava o posto de governador-geral do Brasil, que foi construída uma casa de taipa e palha, no Centro Histórico de Salvador, que por cerca de 200 anos abrigou o Hospital de Caridade, primeiro hospital do Estado da Bahia, sendo o único a prestar assistência aos baianos na época.

Somente em 30 de julho de 1893 foi construído o Hospital Santa Izabel (HSI), no bairro de Nazaré, em Salvador, desativando a antiga

unidade de saúde que funcionava no Pelourinho. O prédio do primeiro hospital passou a ser a sede administrativa da Santa Casa da Bahia e, em 2006, se tornou o Museu da Misericórdia.

A Santa Casa da Bahia é uma associação beneficente de assistência social, que se propõe ao exercício da caridade e prestação de

serviços nas áreas de saúde, ensino, pesquisa, cultura, assistência social e educação, sem subordinação ao Estado ou à Igreja.

MISSÃO DO CARGO:

Analisar e controlar as informações dos projetos durante todo o seu ciclo de vida, além de apoiar a Gerência disponibilizando informações apropriadas e interpretações assertivas de dados que subsidiem as tomadas de decisões. Main responsibilities

  1. Controlar, atualizar, analisar e disponibilizar informações inerentes aos projetos em atendimento às demandas da empresa, cumprindo os requisitos e a metodologia proposta pela área;
  2. Apoiar no cumprimento do Plano de Comunicação vinculado a cada projeto, divulgando dados e gráficos que permitam acompanhar a evolução do projeto;
  3. Receber inputs do andamento de cada projeto e apoiar no fornecimento de outputs que subsidiem os líderes de cada projeto na tomada de decisão, disponibilizando dados que apoiem o cumprimento dos projetos nos prazos, custos e qualidade previstos no escopo;
  4. Apoiar na criação de ferramentas, requisitos e metodologia para garantir que a Gerência forneça à Alta Direção o subsídio para desenvolvimento assertivo dos programas e projetos da empresa;
  5. Fornecer dados e subsídio necessário para a tomada de decisão do Gestor para a realização do dimensionamento e da captação dos recursos necessários para a execução dos projetos, por meio da identificação estruturada de recursos humanos, materiais e financeiros;
  6. Representar a empresa perante os clientes externos, em todos os níveis, durante o período de duração do projeto e, até mesmo, na fase de concepção, quando aplicável, objetivando atender a demanda do cliente;
  7. Manter atualizado e controlado todo o material gerado no projeto que envolva o Plano de Gerenciamento de Riscos apoiando na proposição, sempre que necessário, de soluções que mitiguem ou eliminem os riscos;
  8. Manter a documentação referente ao encerramento do projeto atualizada, validando se os dados estão dispostos de modo a possibilitar a gestão e disseminação do conhecimento em projetos;
  9. Garantir a disponibilização das informações entre os stakeholders envolvidos nos projetos, atuando como facilitador da comunicação;
  10. Realizar, em conjunto com o Líder de Projetos, o controle de materiais e equipamentos disponibilizados aos projetos, por meio de acompanhamento sistemático do controle de ativos do projeto;
  11. Elaborar documentação para desenvolvimento e capacitação da equipe de projetos na metodologia e execução dos projetos na Globalsat do Brasil;
  12. Acompanhar o orçamento departamental e o controle orçamentário dos Projetos, de acordo com os critérios definidos pela Gerência;
  13. Acompanhar e controlar os dados do projeto, garantindo que as informações do ERP estejam sempre atualizadas.
  14. Analisar e controlar os indicadores gerenciais, mantendo a centralização das informações e dos planos de ações para direcionamento das atividades da Gerência de Projetos atualizados e acessíveis.

title: Engineering Manager, Data & AI
description:
Overview

Are you a product-focused engineering leader passionate about hiring and scaling high performance teams? Do you consider yourself a skilled and empathic manager? Do you enjoy leading people, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and improving software development practices? Have you mentored, coached and provided a clear framework for growth for your team members? We might have the perfect opportunity for you.

ABOUT US:

ChowNow is one of the leading players in off-premise restaurant technology. As takeout becomes a vital revenue stream for independent restaurants, our platform helps owners focus on what they do best—serving great food—by offering solutions across the entire digital dining experience. From building branded websites and mobile apps, to powering online orders, managing menus, consolidating delivery, and running targeted marketing, we give restaurants the tools to grow on their own terms.

We support over 20,000 restaurants across North America , helping process $1B+ in gross food sales while saving our partners over $700M in third-party commission fees . Through our white-label ordering solutions, a growing demand network (including Google, Yelp, Apple, and Snap), and a diner-friendly marketplace, we empower independent restaurants to own their customer relationships and avoid inflated pricing and fees charged by 3rd party delivery apps like Uber and Doordash.

Founded in 2012, we’ve navigated rapid growth and transformation—from startup roots through the pandemic boom—and are now beginning an exciting new era under our CEO, Kanika Soni . As we evolve with new leadership and cutting-edge tools, we’re deepening our commitment to helping local restaurants thrive in the digital economy.

About the Position

ChowNow’s Engineering Team has built a modern platform to enable restaurants to streamline their online ordering processes and create a strong digital brand. Our “quality product first” approach to engineering contributes to our success and brand recognition. We’ve reached the time when we need to grow and scale our engineering team to meet the demand of the many exciting new products and features on our roadmap.

We’re looking for an experienced software engineering leader to join our growing engineering team. As an Engineering Manager, you will help us launch reliable and stable products and support new initiatives to continuously improve the experience of our users. You will shape the product, the software architecture, the development process, and the culture.

Most importantly, you will motivate, encourage and lead your team to success, by finding growth opportunities, providing constructive feedback, and combining challenge and support to get the best out of your colleagues. You will be vital in fostering an engineering culture based on collaboration, inclusion, support, measuring and tracking results, and constant improvement.

This position will lead a team of data and AI/ML engineers who are focused on building the systems that will fuel our product led growth strategies. Your team will directly influence new features while simultaneously tackling engineering-driven initiatives to support our efforts to scale.

This role reports to the Chief Technology & Product Officer. Manages a team of 3-4 engineers.

This is a remote role based in the United States. Please note: ChowNow is not eligible to employ in every state and the recruiting team will confirm location and eligibility before moving past initial stages.

What We Love About You

You put restaurants first. You deeply understand the importance of local restaurants and put them at the center of everything you do. You aim to help them not only survive but thrive.

You celebrate diversity. You recognize that diversity and inclusivity matter. You’re committed to progress, which means everyone gets the support and resources they need, no matter who they are. You have an ability to listen to other team members\' ideas and can thrive in an environment that embraces individuality. Everyone’s voice counts.

You raise your hand. You consistently go above and beyond what is asked of you. You help your peers accomplish their tasks while also excelling at accomplishing your own. When you have a smart idea, you raise your hand and share it.

You keep reaching. You set clear ambitious goals. You don’t allow yourself to become complacent with where you’re at and what you’ve done, so you seek out new opportunities and challenges.

What Success Looks Like

Within 30 Days You’ll:

  • Complete our ChowNow onboarding (Ramp Camp) where you’ll learn the ins and outs about ChowNow and our products.
  • Get to know people - your direct team of data engineering, data analytics and AI/ML engineers, as well as the rest of the Engineering organization, Product, and Design.
  • Join team stand-ups, sprint planning, grooming, and more in order to get familiar with the overall product and team processes.
  • Familiarize yourself with the end to end development process and SDLC.
  • Spend deep dive time with the team to learn more about the core products and how they all fit together.
  • Through 1:1s and team sessions, start to understand your team members’ areas of strength and opportunity, in order to be able to provide career guidance and performance reviews.
  • Understand how business goals and compliance affect our internal processes.

Within 60 Days You’ll:

  • Understand our end to end data and ML stack
  • Drive team towards regular cadence of building and release data and ML products at scale
  • Coach your team on building and delivering new data & ML features and capabilities natively in our customer-facing applications
  • Develop strong relationships with Engineering Leadership and Product peers.
  • Review product requirements and design documents, perform code reviews and weigh in on implementation choices.

Within 90 Days You’ll:

  • Collaborate on defining high-level technology roadmap addressing tech debt, product roadmap, and other needs.
  • Provide on-going constructive feedback and guidance to your team members and as part of performance reviews.
  • Support and collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure consistent application of engineering practices.
  • Lead evolution of software development process and practices specially for Data & ML domains while supporting growth of the team and new product initiatives.

You Should Apply If You

  • You have 10+ years of software engineering experience with 5+ years focused on data and ML systems, including 3+ years managing high-performing engineering teams of 5-12 direct reports
  • You have successfully managed teams that built data pipelines and ML-powered products such as recommendation engines, personalization systems, or agentic workflows
  • You have strong knowledge of modern data engineering stack including real-time data processing (Kafka, Spark), data quality monitoring, ETL/ELT pipelines, Snowflake, dbt
  • You have working knowledge of Python, and TensorFlow or PyTorch
  • You have thorough understanding of ML model deployment including CI/CD pipelines, A/B testing frameworks, feature stores, and automated ML pipelines
  • You have hands-on AWS experience with ML services (SageMaker, EMR, Redshift) or GCP equivalent
  • You are passionate about Observability, ML model monitoring, drift detection, and performance optimization at scale
  • Experience with LLMs, RAG systems, vector databases, and transformer architectures is a nice to have
  • You have a passion for team building and a track record of recruiting, onboarding and fostering high-performing engineering teams.
  • You care about the quality of work your team produces.
  • You are a fan of rapid iteration and experimentation. You think about failures as a learning opportunity.
  • You are a thoughtful mentor and leader who loves supporting your team and collaborating with others to achieve great things.
  • You thrive in environments supporting your growth, and where you can support others.
  • You are passionate with a contagious energy, encouraging those around you to pursue their goals.

About Our Benefits

  • Expected Base Salary Range: $201,875 - $262,500 depending on candidate location
  • Ongoing training and growth opportunities.
  • A "Best Place to Work" winner multiple times where we focus on creating a great employee experience.
  • Rock solid medical, dental, and vision plans.
  • Mental Health Coverage - we offer several programs to support your mental health and wellness goals.
  • Unlimited Paid Vacation. We expect you to work hard, but still enjoy your personal life
  • 7 weeks of baby bonding time for all new parents (within the first year of birth or adoption), 8 Weeks of Paid Pregnancy Leave.
  • 401(k) Matching
  • Employer-contributing student loan assistance program or continuing education reimbursement program
  • Commuter benefits (including Uber Pool).

  • Pet insurance for your fur babies
  • Consistent & fair leadership: we’ll share info, set clear goals, show you respect, and treat everyone fairly.
  • Enough freedom to spread your wings while still holding you accountable.

title: Clinical Research Lead-Oncology
description:
Overview

At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees around the world work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We’re looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.

Purpose

The Clinical Research Lead (CRL) is a strategic, field-based scientific leader responsible for driving the execution of Lilly clinical trials through exceptional investigator engagement and site performance management. This role is pivotal in ensuring Lilly’s portfolio is prioritized at high-performing sites and that trials are delivered with quality, speed, and insight. CRLs combine deep therapeutic and scientific knowledge with strategic agility to influence investigators, elevate protocol understanding, and co-develop tailored enrollment strategies in existing and new therapeutic areas. They serve as trusted partners to investigators—building strong, enduring relationships that improve return on enrollment and position Lilly as the sponsor of choice. CRLs partner closely with internal Lilly teams (including Clinical Development and Medical Affairs) to ensure that insights from the field shape development strategies and that development strategies are delivered with operational excellence and scientific clarity. Where applicable the CRL may also represent Investigator Engagement with Regulatory and External Bodies and help shape the country-level clinical trial landscape.

Primary Responsibilities

Clinical Investigator Management

  • Accountable for the full spectrum of investigator engagement from identification and qualification through enrollment, and support database lock, and study closeout
  • Serve as a clinical trial scientific ambassador, ensuring investigators deeply understand protocol intent, scientific rationale, and patient eligibility requirements
  • Develop and sustain strategic, high-trust relationships with investigators that span trials and therapeutic areas
  • Influence enrollment by co-creating tailored recruitment strategies aligned with site capabilities, patient population realities, and study objectives
  • Proactively find opportunities to reach new patients, accelerate enrollment and increase impact at priority sites, including for example, novel site models, community-based research initiatives etc
  • Capture and elevate critical insights from sites to optimize feasibility, protocol design, and study conduct

Clinical Trial Management

  • Lead site-level strategy and risk planning to ensure strong and predictable enrollment and data delivery
  • Leverage performance metrics to anticipate issues, intervene decisively, and maintain momentum toward clinical milestones
  • Drive inspection readiness as a continuous discipline across sites
  • Collaborate across functions and with vendor partners to resolve operational barriers, ensuring delivery with speed and quality
  • Maintain advanced understanding of local treatment paradigms and standard of care to influence strategic country/site selection and protocol localization
  • Provide oversight and quality assurance for vendor monitoring, escalating risks proactively
  • Where applicable, lead end-to-end management of Post-Marketing Safety Studies in compliance with local regulations

Business Management and Engagement

  • Cultivate a portfolio of strategically aligned, high-impact investigators who consistently prioritize Lilly trials
  • Enable an exceptional investigator experience by being a responsive, knowledgeable, and valued scientific partner
  • Collaborate cross-functionally (e.g., Medical, Clinical, Study Delivery) to align on trial and site priorities, troubleshooting challenges with urgency and creativity
  • Conduct data-informed site prospecting and prioritization, contributing to trial competitiveness and regional strategic execution
  • Maintain scientific fluency and therapeutic expertise to lead meaningful, solutions-focused discussions with site personnel
  • Act as a key liaison between field teams, vendors, and investigators, ensuring alignment, shared purpose, and continuous knowledge transfer
  • Partner closely with field team colleagues to elevate the investigator and site experience, ensuring seamless collaboration and improving enrollment outcomes and Investigator relationships

Country / Regulatory Engagement (where applicable)

  • Represent Investigator Engagement with regulatory agencies, ethics committees, and national research organizations in countries/territory
  • Influence the clinical trial ecosystem to improve regulatory agility and operational feasibility
  • Ensure that local requirements are translated into compliant, efficient trial execution and that Lilly’s internal processes reflect evolving country landscapes
  • Partner with leadership to identify and align regional initiatives and contribute to enterprise-wide clinical development success

Qualifications

Minimum Qualification Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent; strong preference for scientific, clinical, or health-related fields
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in clinical research or pharmaceutical industry with experience directly interacting with or working with HCPs and clinical sites
  • Minimum 2 years of relevant clinical or therapeutic area experience in Oncology

Other Information/Additional Preferences:

  • Advanced degree in a scientific or clinical field (PharmD, PhD, MD, or MSc preferred)
  • Excellent understanding of GCP, clinical development and operations, and trial lifecycle
  • Demonstrated understanding of the therapeutic landscape and standards of care, with the ability to apply this knowledge to decision making
  • Proven ability to build credibility and influence HCP community through scientific acumen and relationship strength
  • Strategic approach with demonstrated success in delivering results in complex, fast-paced environments
  • Data-driven decision-making skills; ability to interpret and act on performance and operational metrics
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and organizational skills
  • Deep therapeutic area knowledge and familiarity with local clinical research ecosystems
  • Experience directly influencing clinical site performance and driving enrollment success
  • Track record of delivering or exceeding performance targets in a collaborative matrix environment
  • Experience working with regulators or national bodies in support of clinical trial delivery
  • English fluency and proficiency in local language(s) as needed

Travel Requirements

  • Willingness to travel extensively (60-80%)

title: Pre-Award Specialist
description:
Overview

University of Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus

Department: Cancer Center

Working Title: Pre-Award Specialist

Position #: – Requisition #: 37750

Job Summary:

The Oncology Clinical Research Pre Award Specialist is responsible for developing, negotiating, finalizing and reviewing budgets for clinical trials conducted by faculty members of the University of Colorado Cancer Center at University of Colorado Hospital (UCH). This position requires discretion, analytical skill and personal responsibility to identify, research, collaborate and creatively solve problems in a changing environment while remaining within system, institutional, and state fiscal policies. This position works extensively with industry sponsors, CU finance contacts, clinical staff, faculty members, the University of Colorado Hospital, administrative staff throughout the University, as well as representatives from various departments and CU Medicine. A lot of training is provided up front as this position must learn a Medicare Coverage Analysis (MCA), oncology clinical trial protocols, and processes and procedures of the oncology clinical trial Post Award specialist, the oncology clinical trial finance/billing specialist, and clinic staff.

Job trainings and functions include reviewing and analyzing complex oncology clinical trial protocols, drafting a study-specific budget to account for all procedural and labor costs, working with the clinical trial system OnCoreTM, calendar builders and Project/Research managers to ensure all costs are properly accounted for. This position is responsible for contracts/ grants solicitation and administration, grant/agreement preparation, review and negotiation, regulatory compliance, sponsor communication and pre-award management. This position will have budgetary oversight and is responsible for the advancement of oncology clinical trial contracts and amendments sponsored by industry, cooperative groups, federal grants/contracts and investigator initiated clinical trials.

Key Responsibilities

Specific Examples of Work Performed (All Levels):

  • Review clinical trial protocols in order to draft a study-specific budget that accounts for all procedural and labor costs.

  • Negotiate budgets with industry sponsors.

  • Review and negotiate contractual payment terms.

  • Work with the Clinical Research Administration Office (CRAO) to review and approve final contracts (budget related sections and exhibits).

  • Work with OnCoreTM calendar builders to ensure financial information in OnCoreTM accurately reflects procedures, rates and prices in the negotiated budgets.

  • Review contractual documents to ensure final negotiated terms have been incorporated.

  • Route contractual documents for non-budget increase amendments.

  • Collaborate with Finance Specialists, Regulatory Affairs and Clinical Coordinators to ensure the negotiated budget terms are understood and billed correctly.

  • Complete pre-award reviews using OnCoreTM and train other finance team members in this task if required.

Additional Duties for Level II:

  • Experience with clinical studies calendar specifications and protocol/subject related procedures.

  • Work with Clinical Project Managers and demonstrate advanced research budgeting knowledge.

Additional Duties for Level III:

  • Train Oncology Clinical Trial Budget Specialist I in the clinical trials management software OnCoreTM.

  • Train Oncology Clinical Trial Budget Specialist I in budget management and negotiation.

  • Train Oncology Clinical Trial Budget Specialist I in budget calendar specifications and protocol/subject related procedures.

  • Act as resource to assist other Clinical Research Budget Specialists as needed.

  • Identify process improvement opportunities and involve others across interrelated teams to evaluate.

Work Location

Remote – this role is eligible to work remotely, but the employee must be in the United States.

Why Join Us

The University of Colorado Cancer Center stands at the forefront of cancer research and patient care in Colorado. As the state's only National Cancer Institute (NCI) designated Comprehensive Cancer Center, we hold a prestigious distinction recognizing our contributions to research, clinical trials, prevention, and cancer control. Our guiding vision is to prevent and conquer cancer, together. Our mission is to unite our community to overcome cancer through innovation, discovery, prevention, early detection, multidisciplinary care, and education.

We have more than 300 members, including physicians and researchers, who conduct patient-centered research to develop innovative technologies and treatments. We also employ nearly 300 staff members who help expand the reach of the CU Cancer Center. Our expertise across cancer types enables world-class treatment and hope for patients with difficult cancers.

Why work for the University?

We offer amazing benefits, including generous holiday, vacation and sick leave. The University of Colorado offers a comprehensive benefits package including:

  • Medical: Multiple plan options

  • Dental: Multiple plan options

  • Additional Insurance: Disability, Life, Vision

  • Retirement 401(a) Plan: Employer contributes 10% of gross pay

  • Paid Time Off: Accruals over the year

  • Vacation Days: 22/year (maximum accrual 352 hours)

  • Sick Days: 15/year (unlimited maximum accrual)

  • Holiday Days: 10/year

  • Tuition Benefit: Employees have access to this benefit on all CU campuses

  • ECO Pass: Reduced rate RTD Bus and light rail service

There are many additional perks and programs with CU Advantage.

To see what benefits are available, please visit:

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

Oncology Clinical Trial Pre Award Specialist I (Entry):

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in finance, business administration, healthcare or other related field.

Oncology Clinical Trial Pre Award Specialist II (Intermediate):

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in finance, business administration, healthcare or other related field.

  • Two (2) years of professional experience working in Oncology Clinical Research Finance.

Oncology Clinical Trial Pre Award Specialist III (Senior):

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in finance, business administration, healthcare or other related field.

  • Three (3) years of professional experience working in Oncology Clinical Research Finance.

Substitutions for all levels: Related experience in budget, finance, business administration or clinical field may substitute for the degree on a year-for-year basis.

Preferred Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications for Oncology Clinical Trial Pre Award Specialist I:

  • Experience working with clinical trials management software, preferably OnCoreTM

  • One (1) or more years’ experience in a clinical or clinical research setting.

  • Six (6) months or more experience reading and understanding clinical research protocols, specifically oncology, is preferred.

  • Experience managing budgets.

  • Experience with clinical studies calendar specifications and protocol/subject related procedures.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

All Levels:

  • Good comprehension of contract terminology and ability to draft and negotiate contract budget terms.

  • Ability to work across different departments.

  • Organizational skills, ability to multi-task, adapt to change, and handle competing priorities.

  • Financial analytical skills and ability to troubleshoot problems and pursue resolutions.

  • Critical thinking and decision-making with strong attention to detail.

  • Logical thinking with the ability to learn and process large amounts of information.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Familiarity with medical and clinical research budgeting concepts.

  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel.

How to Apply:

For full consideration, please submit the following documents:

1. A letter of interest describing relevant job experiences as they relate to listed job qualifications (use if a cover letter is necessary)

2. Curriculum vitae / Resume

3. Three to five professional references with contact details

Questions should be directed to: Kari Mancillas,

Applications will be accepted until September 20, 2025.

The starting salary range for this position has been established as a hiring range. Entry - $48,070-$61,145; Intermediate - $52,312-$66,541; Senior - $56,553-$71,936.

If you have prior state-classified service in the same class series, your pay may be set higher per the state Step Pay Program. For more information, visit the Step Pay Program page.

We’re looking for a Lead Software Engineer (AI Data Systems) to join our growing AI team and help build the critical infrastructure that powers the future of intelligent, agent-driven systems at Upwork. You’ll be responsible for collecting high-quality training data, building scalable featurization pipelines, and delivering performant systems to support model training and inference at scale.

This role is built for Explorers , engineers who thrive in ambiguity, move fast with instinct, and are energized by greenfield challenges. Instead of narrowly scoped specialists, we’re hiring T-shaped engineers : individuals with a breadth of skills across the stack and deep expertise in at least one technical area. You’ll be one of our foundational hires, pushing past the known, building fast in Python, and helping us shape our technology and our team. Experience in startups, AI/ML research environments, or similarly dynamic settings is essential, as we’re solving problems that demand speed, curiosity, and adaptability.

If you’re passionate about AI infrastructure, thrive in early-stage environments, and want to help us set the standard for how agentic systems are built and deployed at scale, this is your opportunity.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement systems to collect and curate high-quality training datasets for supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning use cases.
  • Build scalable featurization and preprocessing pipelines to transform raw data into structured inputs for AI/ML model development.
  • Partner with ML engineers and researchers to define data requirements and production workflows that support LLM-based agents and autonomous AI systems.
  • Lead the development of infrastructure that enables experimentation, evaluation, and deployment of machine learning models in production environments.
  • Support orchestration and real-time inference pipelines using Python and modern cloud-native tools, ensuring low-latency and high availability.
  • Mentor engineers and foster a high-performance, collaborative engineering culture grounded in technical excellence and curiosity.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment with product, infrastructure, and research stakeholders, ensuring clarity on progress, goals, and architecture.

  • Strong software engineering background with deep experience in building data collection, transformation, and featurization pipelines at scale.
  • Proficiency in Python, including async programming and concurrency tools, as well as data-centric frameworks such as Pandas, Spark, or Apache Beam.
  • Familiarity with ML model development workflows and infrastructure, including dataset versioning, experiment tracking, and model evaluation.
  • Experience deploying and scaling AI systems in cloud environments such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Proven success operating in highly ambiguous environments such as research labs, startups, or fast-paced product teams.
  • A track record of working with or alongside high-caliber peers in top engineering teams, research groups, or startup ecosystems.
  • Growth mindset, strong communication skills, and a commitment to inclusive collaboration and continuous learning.

Come change how the world works

At Upwork, you’ll shape the future of work for a global, remote-first workforce, creating economic opportunities for professionals worldwide. While we have a physical office in Palo Alto, we currently hire full-time employees in 21 U.S. states, making it easier than ever to join our mission from wherever you call home.

Our culture is built on trust, risk-taking, customer focus, and excellence, all in service of our core mission: to create economic opportunities so people have better lives.
