General Description:

The Sustainability Manager will be responsible for driving the company’s sustainability strategy with a strong focus on Scope 3 emissions. This role will identify and mitigate sustainability risks, embed sustainable practices into procurement and supply chain operations, manage sustainability data and reporting, and communicate progress transparently to internal and external stakeholders. The role will report to the Head of Procurement & Sustainability Excellence.

Essential Functions:

  • Develop, implement, and monitor the company’s sustainability strategy with emphasis on Scope 3 emissions reduction, ensuring alignment with corporate goals and values.
  • Manage sustainability budgets, including projects and future financial projections through 2027.
  • Identify, assess, and prioritize sustainability risks and opportunities across the value chain; maintain and update climate risk mapping (e.g., Power BI dashboards based on BSI data).
  • Integrate climate-related risks into enterprise risk management (ERM) systems and mitigation plans, and ensure effective tracking and follow-up.
  • Establish and maintain accurate Scope 3 data tables, target-setting frameworks, and emissions footprint repositories.
  • Track and report supplier sustainability data to meet internal needs and external obligations (e.g., sustainability reports, Hong Kong Stock Exchange requirements).
  • Collaborate with sourcing managers (primarily direct, with some indirect) to embed Scope 3 reduction into category strategies, sourcing decisions, and implementation plans.
  • Develop and implement sustainable procurement policies, including ESG sourcing guidance, supplier evaluation criteria, and performance measurement.
  • Lead supplier engagement initiatives, including climate questionnaires, maturity assessments, outreach, and training sessions, to improve supplier performance on sustainability.
  • Support supplier development programs, including diversity, audits, partnerships, and capability-building initiatives.
  • Educate suppliers and third-party vendors on climate awareness and emissions reduction expectations.
  • Research and evaluate new sustainability technologies and trends (e.g., AI resource use, green chemistry, sustainable construction, and packaging) for business impact and adoption potential.
  • Provide regular updates and reports to procurement leadership and other stakeholders (e.g., PLT updates, ESG sourcing guidance, sustainability reports).
  • Design and deliver internal sustainability education and awareness programs, including recorded webinars and training for procurement teams.
  • Ensure compliance with evolving regulations, industry best practices, and responsible procurement due diligence requirements.
  • Build business cases for sustainability initiatives, drive organizational change, and act as a trusted advisor on sustainable business practices.

Minimum Requirements – Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Sustainability, Environmental Science, Procurement, Supply Chain, Business, or related field (advanced degree preferred).
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in sustainability management, with proven expertise in Scope 3 emissions.

Other Experience:

  • Strong understanding of sustainability and ESG principles, with practical application in procurement and supply chain.
  • Experience developing and implementing supplier engagement and responsible procurement programs.

  • Excellent project management, organizational, and stakeholder engagement skills.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with experience preparing clear reports and presentations for diverse audiences.

Overview

Job ID: | Amazon Logistica do Brasil - F95

O SC (Sort Center) está em busca de profissionais engajados e apaixonados por inovação para ajudar a desenvolver um processo logístico de classe mundial, garantindo entregas dentro do prazo e com a máxima eficiência de custo. O objetivo da nossa equipe é operar com excelência, otimizando capacidades e monitorando em tempo real as operações do Sort Center no Brasil, realizando o acompanhamento hora a hora e fornecendo análises detalhadas dos dados operacionais.

Essa posição requer um profissional proativo e com espírito de liderança. Você representará uma posição estratégica nas operações de transporte da Amazon, enquanto trabalhamos constantemente para melhorar os níveis de serviço, a eficiência das capacidades e a otimização dos custos do Sort Center Brasil. Isso garantirá que as promessas feitas aos nossos valiosos clientes sejam cumpridas de forma consistente.

Uma pessoa especialista em operações de transporte facilita o fluxo de informações entre diferentes partes interessadas (transportadoras/hubs/armazéns) e resolve quaisquer possíveis problemas que afetem a experiência do cliente e a continuidade dos negócios. Além disso, trabalhará em operações externas com relacionamento FCs / ATS Middle Mile / TOM e AMZL, garantindo que nossas capacidades sejam sempre atingidas com excelência e ainda garantindo a visibilidade dessas capacidades para as áreas parceiras e para a gerência sênior da operação.

Como especialista em transporte, você deve ser capaz de resolver problemas com agilidade, utilizando ferramentas internas e tomando decisões assertivas em tempo real. É essencial compreender os requisitos, analisar dados, identificar tendências e impulsionar a experiência do cliente sem impactar os prazos estabelecidos. Conhecimentos básicos em logística e habilidades de comunicação claras, tanto na forma escrita quanto oral, são indispensáveis. Além disso, o profissional deve propor melhorias nos processos e ter a determinação de implementá-las até a conclusão.

Essa posição estará envolvida na expansão do Sort Center no Brasil, trabalhando em turnos de 3x2. Modelo de trabalho: Presencial, em turnos pela escala 3x2. É necessário ter disponibilidade para trabalhar em horários/turnos/áreas flexíveis, incluindo fins de semana, noites e/ou feriados.

Key job responsibilities

  • Estabelecer comunicação eficiente com clientes externos (ATS Middle Mile, TOM, Time de Operações do Sort Center e AMZL) e clientes internos (centros de atendimento ROC, estações de entrega);
  • Possuir capacidade de extrair dados de vários bancos de dados (usando Excel, Access, SQL e/ou outros sistemas de gerenciamento de dados) e realizar relatórios e análises ad hoc conforme necessário é um diferencial desejável;
  • Desenvolver e/ou compreender métricas de desempenho relevantes para impulsionar os resultados do negócio;
  • Entender rapidamente o impacto das tendências nos resultados comerciais e tomar decisões com base nos dados disponíveis;
  • Encaminhar de forma estruturada problemas ou variações nas informações e dados para os proprietários e equipes relevantes, garantindo a execução de soluções;
  • Trabalhar dentro de várias restrições de tempo para atender às necessidades críticas dos negócios, mensurando e identificando as atividades realizadas;
  • Responder pelo gerenciamento de capacidade de linha e gerenciamento de volume, incluindo a realização de uploads de limites de capacidade no sistema;
  • Garantir visibilidade às atividades de Capacidades, fornecendo suporte direto ao time de operações.

A day in the life

O Sort Center é o Middle Mile (MM), uma parte da estrutura da Amazon Transportation Service (ATS), onde os pacotes são enviados para serem consolidados de diferentes origens e serem classificados e enviados ao destino para melhorar a velocidade de entrega, a ocupação do veículo e a frequência da rota. A estratégia do Sort Center para o Brasil tem como objetivo desenvolver nossa rede de transporte apoiando a expansão dos programas da AMZL, Amazon Air e Market Place.

Ready to Join Us?

title: Digital Media Buyer - Remote, Latin America
description:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for someone with a strong media and advertising foundation; well versed in Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Ads, Google Campaign Manager, planning, presenting, executing, and optimizing all media strategies.

Our ideal candidate thrives on data and is adept at using it to craft the highest performing campaigns possible. We’re seeking someone who is well organized, attentive to detail, and most importantly is as passionate as the rest of our team is about driving results overnight and building stronger brands over time. Above all, we think having the right positive, engaged personality is crucial for our work culture and to create a passionate tie to our agency’s thriving team philosophy.


Media Buying & Strategy
  • Execute data-driven media buying strategies that align with client goals and target audiences.
  • Conduct market research to identify the most effective media channels.
  • Analyze historical campaign data to inform media mix and performance projections.
  • Recommend channel-specific budgets and optimize spend based on performance metrics.
  • Stay current on media trends, platform updates, and emerging technologies, including AI and automation tools.
Campaign Execution & Management
  • Launch, manage, and optimize paid media campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, and programmatic display.
  • Monitor real-time campaign performance and proactively adjust bids, budgets, and targeting to improve efficiency and results.
  • Track key KPIs such as leads, cost per acquisition (CPA), cost per lead (CPL), engagement rates, web traffic, and form fills.
Budget Management
  • Manage and allocate media budgets effectively across channels to maximize campaign performance.
  • Maintain daily, weekly, and monthly budget pacing and ensure campaigns remain on schedule and within financial targets.
  • Identify opportunities for cost-saving without compromising campaign effectiveness.
Skills & Qualifications
  • 3+ years of experience in media buying, preferably in an agency setting or with companies providing B2B services/recruiting to software development firms.
  • Strong experience in paid media platforms (Google Ads, Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Ads, programmatic platforms).
  • Proven track record of managing performance marketing campaigns with a focus on results.
  • Proficiency in analytics and attribution tools (Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, third-party trackers, etc.)
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Proficiency with media buying and planning tools.
Company Benefits
  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

Key Responsibilities:
• Collaborate with marketing, social media, and partnerships teams to develop graphic concepts that align with brand strategy and campaign objectives.
• Create high-quality designs for a variety of channels and uses, including:
o Digital assets (ads, email graphics, website banners)
o Print collateral (flyers, brochures, posters)
o In-store displays and signage (POS)
o Trade show booth designs and event graphics
o Social media content (static posts, carousels, and visual templates)
o Product and packaging files (print-ready with proper die lines and specs)
o Sales presentation templates & materials
• Prepare and package final artwork files for both digital and print production.
• Maintain and evolve ALP’s visual identity across all platforms and materials.
• Ensure all creative output adheres to brand and regulatory guidelines, including typography, color palette, and logo usage.
• Work with production vendors and manufacturers to ensure final output meets specifications and quality standards.
• Review proofs and pre-press files for accuracy.
• Manage multiple design projects simultaneously, balancing priorities and meeting tight deadlines.
• Maintain an organized archive of creative assets for easy access and reuse.
Required Skills & Qualifications:
• A design portfolio for the application is mandatory.
• 5+ years of professional graphic design experience, preferably in consumer goods or ecommerce-native brands.
• Advanced proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop.
• Strong understanding of print production, die lines, color management, and packaging design.
• Proven ability to translate brand strategy into compelling visuals.
• Exceptional attention to detail with a commitment to high-quality work.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-output environment.

This is a remote position. Only US based candidates will be considered.

title: Squad Leader
description:
Job description

Na INFLOR, acreditamos que tecnologia só faz sentido quando conecta pessoas, inovação e resultados . Por isso, estamos em busca de um(a) Squad Leader que seja apaixonado(a) por pessoas e por tecnologia, para liderar squads responsáveis por desenvolver produtos que transformam o nosso negócio e o setor em que atuamos.

Queremos alguém que una liderança ágil, visão de negócio e sensibilidade humana , inspirando os times a entregarem valor de forma consistente, sustentável e com propósito.

Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de:

Conectar estratégia e execução, ajudando nossos times a irem além.

Fomentar colaboração, autonomia e alto desempenho em squads multidisciplinares.

Ser agente de inovação e melhoria contínua.

Apoiar o crescimento e desenvolvimento das pessoas, construindo vínculos reais e um ambiente saudável.

Se você busca desafios, impacto e realização em um lugar que valoriza tanto as pessoas quanto a tecnologia, essa vaga é para você!

Venha fazer parte da 5ª melhor empresa para trabalhar no Espírito Santo!

Se inscreva!

Main responsibilities

Fará parte do seu dia a dia:

  • Liderar squads multidisciplinares, garantindo entregas de valor alinhadas à estratégia do negócio;
  • Facilitar e fortalecer práticas ágeis (Scrum, Kanban etc.), assegurando cerimônias eficazes e engajadas;
  • Estimular autonomia, accountability e colaboração nos times;
  • Apoiar no desenvolvimento das pessoas por meio de escuta ativa, sensibilidade relacional e criação de vínculos reais, conduzindo PDIs, 1:1s e momentos de feedback;
  • Mediar conflitos, criando um ambiente saudável, transparente e de alta performance;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com Product Owners e stakeholders, garantindo clareza de prioridades e qualidade nas entregas;
  • Identificar gargalos, riscos e impedimentos, atuando de forma proativa na resolução;
  • Analisar indicadores de performance e direcionar melhorias contínuas;
  • Ser a ponte entre squads, assegurando comunicação clara, integração e alinhamento.

Requirements and skills

O que esperamos de você

  • Experiência sólida em gestão de squads ágeis e aplicação prática do Scrum;
  • Habilidade em liderança, comunicação clara, gestão de conflitos e capacidade genuína de se conectar com pessoas;
  • Protagonismo, responsabilidade e foco em resultados;
  • Conhecimento em gestão de projetos, ciclo de vida de software e métricas ágeis (throughput, lead time, velocity, qualidade etc.);
  • Olhar crítico e analítico para indicadores e processos.

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios, mas desejáveis):

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de software (C#, Vue.js, MVC, orientação a objetos);
  • Vivência em empresas de produtos SaaS;
  • Certificações ágeis (CSM, PSM II/III, SAFe, LeSS, Kanban Management Professional);
  • Experiência próxima de times técnicos;
  • Conhecimento em Lean, frameworks ágeis e gestão de serviços (ITIL).

Additional information

Benefícios que fazem a diferença!

Aqui, valorizamos o seu bem-estar e desenvolvimento profissional! Confira os benefícios que oferecemos para que você tenha mais qualidade de vida e motivação no dia a dia:

Overview

Contracting Manager

What you will be doing:

The Contracting Manager is responsible for sourcing and management for contracts within the purchased services service line, which will include multiple contracts or relationships. Specifically, Contracting Managers will be responsible for: Supplier and Member Relationship Management; Support with Development of Opportunity Road Map; Full (End to End) Sourcing Process; GPO and Member Contract Negotiations; Project Status Tracking and Report Out to Member.

Responsibilities

  1. Responsibility #1 – 20%

  2. Responsibility #2 – 40%

title: Medical Specialist
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Medical Specialist role at Innodata Inc.

Job title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About Innodata

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company with more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities worldwide. We are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for many large technology companies and leading firms across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with a Master’s or PhD in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will shape how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform improvements to AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses on topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts that assess the model’s reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete an English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory and non-billable.

How to Apply

If interested, please share your updated resume at the contact provided by the recruiter.

Job Details

  • Seniority level : Internship
  • Employment type : Contract
  • Job function : Health Care Provider
  • Industries : Business Consulting and Services

title: Senior Contracts Management Specialist
description:
Overview

World Vision is hiring a Senior Contracts Management Specialist to serve in the Transformational Engagement division.

Role: Senior Contracts Management Specialist

Reports to: Senior Manager, Fundraising

Location: Remote

Required Experience: Bachelor\'s degree or equivalent work experience (eight years) required. In addition to education or education equivalent, requires 3-5 years\' work experience in contracts, or related area.

Work Authorization: Must be authorized to work in the U.S.A. for any employer.

Estimated Salary Range: $70,000-$82,000

The Job

The Sr. Contracts Management Specialist will manage the end to end contracting process for Channel Development and Management (CDM) in collaboration with the Senior Contracts Manager. Consult and advise Channel business owners and staff on partnership and service purchasing needs, organizational policies and procedures, and contract management strategy. In collaboration with the Senior Contract Manager, conduct and facilitate multifaceted contract negotiations with external marketing partners inclusive of writing and editing contracts. Assist with state solicitation filings and reports in accordance with each individual state\'s regulation. Serve as subject matter expert and liaison between CDM fundraising channels and Legal, Finance, Vendor Contract Services (VCS) and Planning, Analysis and Reporting (PAR). Help carry out our Christian organization\'s mission, vision, and strategies. Personify the ministry of World Vision by witnessing to Christ and ministering to others through life, deed, word and sign.

Responsibilities Will Include

  • Keep Christ central in individual and corporate life. Actively participate in and contribute to the spiritual disciplines of the organization (Christian conduct, devotions, chapel, prayer, worship); incorporate WV Core Values into decisions within scope of role.
  • Provide Contract, Accounts Payable, State Filing and Reporting, and Operational Services to the CDM Division.
  • Contract Creation, Review and Compliance:
  • Write and execute custom contracts and/or create variations of standard contract templates for single and multi-year agreements that may exceed $15M in total value.
  • Manage, update and/or amend contract terms as required.
  • Monitor contract renewal dates, issue new contracts and close out old contracts.
  • Draft, review and periodically update standard contract templates for WV Artists, tour representatives, event sponsorships, and other high yield fundraising opportunities.
  • Ensure fulfillment of deliverables, including invoicing and payments, account reconciliation and close-outs, extensions, renewals, and internal and external reporting. Comply with internal SLA\'s and gain WV Legal approval as required.
  • Manage year-end contract process.
  • Maintain clear and accurate records related to contract proposals, correspondence, contact data, and approvals in order to meet regulatory requirements for contractual documentation.
  • Operational Support:
  • Create campaign codes, bundles, and event ID\'s for partner events.
  • Work with Accounts Payable and appropriate WVUS departments to ensure proper payment to artists and vendors based on contractual agreements through invoice processing, requisition/PO creation, and acting as a bill owner and buyer.
  • Conduct background screenings and process/file vendor business documentation.
  • Conduct research on various contracts, sponsorship acquisitions or other topics as needed.
  • Produce detailed, accurate financial reporting and analysis for external partners, Finance, and CDM staff.
  • Assist Senior Contract Manager with high volume of state professional solicitor registrations, contract filings, and reports, ensuring timely compliance with each\'s laws and reporting deadlines.
  • Serve as contract consultants and service representative for CDM departments. Advise business owners, organizational leaders, internal fundraising staff, and partner account executives on the internal contracting process, relevant policies and procedures, contract costs, and the terms of new or existing agreements.
  • Consult and collaborate with Legal, Finance and other internal and/or external subject matter experts and key stakeholders in vetting contracts, while meeting business owner expectations and protecting WVUS interests.
  • Work collaboratively with team members when assigned to work as a member of a team.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
  • Maintain awareness of corporate goals, objectives, organizational announcements, and activities. Reference and follow organizational policies and procedures, seeking clarity as needed.

    • You Bring These Skills

    • Financial Spreadsheets: Proficiency in financial spreadsheets and number calculations.
    • Detail Orientation: Strong attention to detail, especially for contracts, CRM and CLM.
    • Critical Thinking: Ability to see the big picture and understand how actions affect other processes.
    • Multitasking: Capability to handle multiple tasks efficiently.

    Requirements

    Bachelor\'s degree or equivalent work experience (eight years) required. In addition to education or education equivalent, requires 3-5 years\' work experience in contracts, or related area. A demonstrated ability to negotiate and manage projects/processes is required. Broad understanding of general accounting principles, finance and administration, contract management, fundraising and/or marketing is required.

    Salary & Benefits

    WVUS Pay Grade Level: 222

    Estimated hiring range is $70,000-$82,000.

    This range applies to locations with a market similar to our Federal Way and Washington D.C. offices. A different range may apply based on your work location.

    Job offers are based on relevant qualifications and pay equity.

    Please indicate your salary expectations in the application.

    In addition, we have a robust and comprehensive benefits package to round our total compensation package. Click here to learn more.

    About World Vision

    We\'re a global Christian humanitarian organization. We partner with children, families, and their communities to empower them as they reach their full potential by tackling the causes of poverty and injustice. For nearly 75 years, World Vision has followed Jesus\' example to show unconditional love to the poor and oppressed. We serve every child regardless of faith.

    What Happens Next?

    Applications are reviewed weekly. Short-listed candidates will be contacted for an initial phone conversation with a recruiter. If questions arise on our end about your application, we will message you to learn more. We encourage you to submit a PDF resume and a cover letter! Our goal is to fill this vacancy with the right person in the shortest amount of time.

Language Ability: Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and standard operating procedures. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from clients, peers, and technical field staff.

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. Location

Remote

Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.

When available, the salary range posted for this position reflects the projected hiring range for new hire, full-time salaries in U.S. and/or Canada locations, not including equity or benefits. .75% of incentive target for each 1% of revenue attainment up to 50% of quota;

1.5% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 50% and 75%;

1% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 75% and 100%; and once performance exceeds 100% attainment, incentive rates are at or above 1% for each 1% of attainment with no cap on incentive compensation.

  • 2–4 years of overall professional experience, with at least 1–2 years directly managing Instagram, TikTok, and Google Ads for hospitality, entertainment, or lifestyle brands.

  • Familiarity with TikTok’s creator tools and Instagram Reels best practices.
  • Background in hospitality, nightlife, or entertainment environments.
  • Passion for fun, community-focused spaces.

  • Engagement Rate: Improve average likes, comments, shares, and saves across platforms.

Job Summary

The Portfolio Manager manages and grows a portfolio of dealer clients across the San Francisco, CA territory with lines of credit ranging from $50,000 to $2.5M within an assigned geographic territory. The primary responsibilities include building and maintaining relationships with clients, optimizing the portfolio through the clients’ use of the line of credit, identifying and mitigating pre-default account risk, and supporting post-default collections on defaulted accounts.

Candidates must live within assigned San Francisco Metro, CA Territory: San Francisco, San Leandro, Oakland, San Bruno, Fremont, Hayward, Union City, Sunnyvale, Burlingame, Belmont, Newark, San Mateo.

Responsibilities

  • Optimize each client’s use of the line of credit within an assigned portfolio whose lines of credit range from $50,000 to $2,500,000 by acting as floor plan subject matter expert to their portfolio of clients.
  • Achieve goals and performance targets as set by the company by regularly engaging with clients in person or virtually by collaborating with internal partners to drive revenue and maximize profitability through prudent account management, controlled growth and risk mitigation.
  • Educate clients on desired performance behaviors, self-service options, and best practices and coach them to ensure compliance with company policies and expectations.
  • Collect and analyze client financial information and various internal reports and dashboards to assess and monitor dealer performance and address with the dealer as appropriate to drive growth and manage risk.
  • Utilize company provided historical data and tools to identify targets for opportunity of growth and determine clients that are having financial distress.
  • Collaborate and strategize with Risk and Recovery department with pre-default risk mitigation and post default collection efforts on defaulted accounts within a specified timeframe. Minimize loss and maximize recovery.
  • Physical inspection of inventory, and accuracy of audits and repossession as necessary. Inspect what is expected to ensure quality control, inventory, audit self- reconciliation, addition of inventory and buying behaviors.
  • Serve as a fiduciary for the company including identifying and reporting to the company any material client or internal non-compliance with company policies, attempted or actual fraud upon the company or any other circumstance that may require identification and reporting to protect the company.
  • Operate with the highest level of integrity and always strive to achieve the best outcome for both the clients and our company.
  • Detailed documentation in Salesforce all prudent conversations, activities and client interactions as required by the company KPI’s. Complete all Salesforce campaigns as required by the company.
  • Responsible for onboarding of new clients to ensure a positive and successful client experience.
  • Cultivate Cox Automotive cross functional business unit relationships and opportunities.
  • Participate and support other projects and initiatives as required.
  • Perform all other duties as assigned.

Job Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Knowledge of the automotive industry (various sectors).
  • Knowledge of the finance industry (various sectors).
  • Proficiency of reading and analyzing financials, such as profit & loss, balance sheet, tax returns and bank statements preferred.
  • Strong financial acumen with working knowledge of key financial tools and terminology.
  • Ability to identify risk indicators through data tools.
  • Ability to communicate a proactive performance plan on continuous basis individually and client level.
  • Strong presentation, verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with ability to interact with clients, collaborate with internal team members and external partners at various levels within the organization.
  • Strong time management skills with ability to manage deadlines.
  • Strong negotiation and collection skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and in a remote environment.
  • Ability to maintain a high level of safety awareness and take necessary safety precautions.
  • Proficient in Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams and Salesforce.

Education and Experience

  • BA/BS with 4+ years related experience in finance, client facing, customer service, B2B, account management and/ or collections required. Candidate can also have a combination of a MS degree and 2+ years, or 8 years of experience in lieu of a degree.
  • Automotive and/or floorplan industry background preferred.
  • Financial knowledge and acumen preferred.

Physical Demands

  • Ability to visit clients at least 60% of the time with occasionally required overnight travel.
  • Ability to sit and stand for extended periods of time.
  • Valid driver’s license is required for this position.

Drug Testing

To be employed in this role, you’ll need to clear a pre-employment drug test. Cox Automotive does not currently administer a pre-employment drug test for marijuana for this position. However, we are a drug-free workplace, so the possession, use or being under the influence of drugs illegal under federal or state law during work hours, on company property and/or in company vehicles is prohibited.

The Company offers eligible employees the flexibility to take as much vacation with pay as they deem consistent with their duties, the company’s needs, and its obligations; seven paid holidays throughout the calendar year; and up to 160 hours of paid wellness annually for their own wellness or that of family members. Employees are also eligible for additional paid time off in the form of bereavement leave, time off to vote, jury duty leave, volunteer time off, military leave, and parental leave.

Through groundbreaking technology and a commitment to stellar experiences for drivers and dealers alike, Cox Automotive employees are transforming the way the world buys, owns, sells – or simply uses – cars. Cox Automotive employees get to work on iconic consumer brands like Autotrader and Kelley Blue Book and industry-leading dealer-facing companies like vAuto and Manheim, all while enjoying the people-centered atmosphere that is central to our life at Cox. title: Clinical Specialist - CAS, Mountain West
description:
Overview

We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on 26 Sep 2025. At Medtronic you can begin a life-long career of exploration and innovation, while helping champion healthcare access and equity for all. You'll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation in a more connected, compassionate world.

A Day in the Life We are seeking a committed professional to join our team. This is a remote position not located at a physical Medtronic site; the candidate hired will be required to reside within the territory and drive to multiple accounts throughout the region. A valid driver’s license is essential for this role.

At Medtronic, your work has a direct and lasting impact—on patients, families, and the future of medicine. As a Clinical Specialist in Cardiac Ablation Solutions, you’re not just supporting procedures—you’re enabling groundbreaking therapies that can help patients reclaim their lives from complex arrhythmias.

This role includes a pathway to become a Mapping Specialist through a structured 6-8 month training program. Experienced clinical professionals joining as Clinical Specialists will have the opportunity to gain deep expertise in mapping systems and complex ablation procedures, positioning them as advanced clinical leaders in the field. This is an ideal opportunity to expand your clinical impact and grow within Medtronic’s Cardiac Ablation Solutions team.

We are seeking a committed professional to join our team, required to reside within the territory and drive to multiple accounts throughout the region. A valid driver's license is essential for this role, which also involves 25% travel outside the territory, presenting opportunities for broader engagement.

Location This position posting is location flexible and can be based in any of the following locations: AZ, NM, CO, UT, NV, ID, MT, or WY.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Provide technical, educational, clinical and sales support to assist the Region in meeting Cardiac Ablation Solutions sales and customer service objectives.
  • Represents Medtronic CAS during ablations procedures to provide troubleshooting and other technical assistance.
  • Receives technical inquiries by customers. Researches solutions to questions or problems (e.g., Catheter, Console, Generator support).
  • Educates and trains physicians, hospital personnel and office staff on technical matters relating to AFS products and related procedures.
  • Assists RM and field training department in educating/training new Clinical Specialists and Account Managers.
  • Provides training and resources for hospital staff to enable them to conduct training for their personnel.
  • Provide Sales Support to help influence revenue growth within the region.
  • Updates sales representatives concerning procedures. Immediately notifies Account Manager regarding issues or problems requiring follow-up.
  • Serves as effective Medtronic CAS representative to physicians and support staff regarding Medtronic CAS products, service and support.
  • Promotes the safe and effective use of Medtronic CAS products and related procedures.
  • Understands national, regional and territory sales objectives. Works in partnership with Account Manager to achieve and exceed goals.

Minimum Requirements

  • High School diploma PLUS a minimum 6 years of work experience in healthcare within an EP, Cath Lab setting or sales in cardiac field.
  • OR Associate degree PLUS a minimum of 4 years of work experience in healthcare within an EP, Cath Lab setting or sales in cardiac field.
  • OR Bachelor degree PLUS a minimum 2 years work experience in healthcare within an EP, Cath Lab setting or sales in cardiac field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Preference will be given to local qualified candidates and candidates with Medtronic experience.
  • B.A./B.S. Degree in nursing, cardiovascular, life sciences, or technical discipline with minimum of four years’ work experience in cardiac field, hospital/clinic or sales.
  • Pacing school/ATI-like training program in addition to BQs.
  • Proven track record with technical training assignments.
  • Experience in the cardiac catheter ablation field, EP lab, in a hospital/clinic or EP medical sales providing technical/clinical support.

Additional Job Requirements

  • Environmental exposure to infectious disease and radiation.
  • Clinical Specialists are required to be within their assigned territory each day to be available as unscheduled needs arise.
  • Clinical Specialists will on occasion be required to travel outside of their assigned territory and possibly overnight.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license.
  • Ability to freely move throughout the facility, use a phone, keyboard and mouse, visually able to interact with personal computers.
  • Must be able to stand/sit/walk for 8 hours a day.
  • Must be able to drive approximately 75% of the time within assigned territory and may require overnight travel.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license and active vehicle insurance policy. Driving record will be reviewed as part of the application.

Cardiovascular Portfolio

Cardiac Ablation Solutions offers cardiac mapping and ablation solutions to treat patients with abnormal heart rhythms. Our vision is to help patients worldwide by advancing innovation for the diagnosis and ablation of cardiac arrhythmias, enabling clinicians to perform procedures with superior outcomes.

Physical Job Requirements

The physical demands described are representative of those that must be met to perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities. For Office Roles: the employee is regularly required to be independently mobile, interact with a computer, and communicate with peers and co-workers.

Benefits & Compensation

Medtronic offers a competitive salary and flexible benefits package. Salary ranges for U.S. locations (excl. PR): $90,000.00 - $110,000.00. The base salary range is applicable across the United States, excluding Puerto Rico and certain CA locations, and may vary based on experience, certification/education, market conditions, and location.

In addition to Base Salary, this position is eligible for a Sales Incentive Plan (SIP). Benefits for regular employees who work 20+ hours per week include health, dental and vision insurance, HSA, FSA, life insurance, disability leave, dependent care spending, tuition assistance, and well-being programs. Regular employees are eligible for 401(k) with employer match, PTO, holidays, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, and other programs. Some benefits may not apply to workers in Puerto Rico.

Further details are available at the link below: Medtronic benefits and compensation plans.

About Medtronic

We lead global healthcare technology and boldly attack the most challenging health problems facing humanity by searching out and finding solutions. Our Mission—to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life—unites a global team of 95,000+ passionate people. We are engineers at heart, putting ambitious ideas to work to generate real solutions for real people.

Learn more about our business, mission, and our commitment to diversity here.

Medtronic will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities.

title: Data Architect / Data Engineer
description:
About Us

At Aravita, we're not just building a product; we're building the future of AI-enabled fresh food operations. We are a fast-paced, innovative startup on a mission to solve complex problems with data. Our culture is built on collaboration, curiosity, and a passion for technology. We're looking for a brilliant Data Engineer / Cloud Architect to join our dynamic team and help us build a scalable, world-class data infrastructure.

The Role

As a Data Engineer / Cloud Architect, you will be at the heart of our data operations. You'll design, build, and maintain our cutting-edge data platform, empowering our entire organization to make data-driven decisions. This is a hands-on role where you will architect robust data pipelines, optimize our cloud environment, and ensure our data is secure, reliable, and accessible.

Your primary responsibilities

  • Designing, developing, and deploying scalable ETL / ELT pipelines using Azure Data Factory and PySpark .
  • Architecting and managing our Databricks environment, leveraging Unity Catalog to build a state-of-the-art Lakehouse architecture .
  • Implementing and managing infrastructure on container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes .
  • Developing monitoring and observability solutions using tools like Grafana to ensure system health and performance.
  • Collaborating with data scientists, analysts, and software engineers to understand data needs and deliver effective solutions.
  • Championing best practices in data governance, data quality, and cloud security.

What You'll Bring

We're looking for a seasoned expert with a passion for building great things. You should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and have a strong foundation in data engineering and cloud principles.

Key Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Data Engineer, Cloud Architect, or a similar role.
  • Strong proficiency in building data pipelines with Azure Data Factory and processing large-scale data with PySpark .
  • Deep, hands-on experience with the Databricks platform , including a strong understanding of Unity Catalog and the principles of Lakehouse architecture .
  • Solid experience with containerization and orchestration using Kubernetes .
  • Familiarity with monitoring and visualization tools, specifically Grafana .
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently.
  • Must currently reside in Brazil . Preference will be given to candidates in the greater São Paulo area to facilitate occasional team meetups.

Why You'll Love Working With Us

We believe that our team is our greatest asset, and we invest in our people accordingly. When you join us, you can expect :

  • Competitive Compensation : An attractive salary and benefits package.
  • Remote-First Culture : The flexibility to work from anywhere in Brazil, with the technology and support you need to succeed.
  • Amazing Startup Environment : A vibrant, inclusive, and collaborative culture where your ideas are valued and your impact is real.
  • Growth Opportunities : The chance to grow your skills and career in a rapidly expanding company.
  • Meaningful Work : The opportunity to work on challenging projects that have a direct impact on our business and customers.

If you are a data visionary ready to make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you!

Behavioral Competency Requirements

Commercial Tenacity

Drive for Results: Works with a sense of urgency to drive tasks through to completion. Pushes self and teammates to meet challenging goals. Sets high standards of excellence for self and teammates. Maintains a clear focus on what needs to be done to achieve end goals for self and team.

Business Sense: Recognizes market trends. Understands the value of organizational and market metrics for carrying through team strategy. Teamwork: Actively collaborates with others to build cohesion and better achieve goals. Offers to help others with their work, even when lacking a direct personal interest. Respects others’ talents, contributions, and perspectives. Openly shares relevant knowledge, expertise, and information.

Consultative Skills

Communication: Conveys ideas and information clearly and concisely. Tailors the method and content to the audience, message, and context. Checks to ensure messages have been understood. Actively listens and asks questions to verify own understanding.

Negotiating: Clarifies goals and balances the objectives of both parties to achieve constructive outcomes. Remains open to creative and alternative possibilities and solutions. Uses both direct and diplomatic communication in negotiations.

title: Senior Qa Engineer (Sql)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior QA Engineer with 7+ years of QA experience to join our U.S. client's software engineering team. Primary duties include testing all new feature enhancements, maintaining test cases, and performing application regression testing. This key individual should have confidence in making decisions, as well as working both independently and as part of a minor, dynamic team where everything you do makes a difference.

Founded in 2003, our client transforms the traditional restaurant point-of-sale (POS) terminal into an integrated 360-degree operational management system. Their solution increases brand loyalty through improved customer experiences, optimizes operations resulting in lower costs, and increases sales volumes through comprehensive analytics and employee performance insights. Over 7,000 locations use their technology today, processing $5 billion in daily sales.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze requirements for new features and enhancements to effectively define, execute, and analyze test plans, cases, and coverage
  • Configure test environments (desktop, SaaS, and mobile) to execute required test cases to validate product releases
  • Find, isolate, document, regress, and track bugs through resolution
  • Review the product user interface for conformity to design guidelines
  • Define and implement metrics to determine test effectiveness, efficiency, and overall product quality, including identification of under-tested components
  • Measure escaped defects (quantity and severity) that reach production; analyze test logs, create test reports, and perform root cause analysis of issues
  • Participate in review meetings to share test case status, discuss concerns and risk items, drive comprehensive test coverage, and advocate for quality in every phase of the development process
  • Identify opportunities for improvement in systems, tools, and processes, as well as drive those improvements to effective adoption

Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 7+ years of software testing experience, including functional, bug verification, regression, user acceptance, and user experience testing
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Knowledge of test case management tools, such as JIRA / Xray
  • Solid SQL skills and familiarity with Microsoft SQL Server
  • Varied environment and delivery modality experience, including desktop, SaaS, and mobile, as well as experience working with Microsoft Azure
  • Extensive knowledge of software, database, and integration testing, including end-to-end test verification across applications / products
  • Interpersonal skills with the ability to empower others and collaborate with peers and stakeholders
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

Desired Experience

  • Automated testing experience with Playwright (or other tools) or desire to learn
  • API testing experience with Postman
  • Familiarity with restaurant or retail order processing, payment processing, and restaurant management

Additional Information

  • Know that your ideas are heard and matter. Think big!
  • Own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart, creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let’s learn from them and be transparent!
  • Be recognized as an individual, no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start : ASAP

title: Data Architect / Data Engineer
description:
About Us

At Aravita, we're not just building a product; we're building the future of AI-enabled fresh food operations. We are a fast-paced, innovative startup on a mission to solve complex problems with data. Our culture is built on collaboration, curiosity, and a passion for technology. We're looking for a brilliant Data Engineer / Cloud Architect to join our dynamic team and help us build a scalable, world-class data infrastructure.

The Role

As a Data Engineer / Cloud Architect, you will be at the heart of our data operations. You'll design, build, and maintain our cutting-edge data platform, empowering our entire organization to make data-driven decisions. This is a hands-on role where you will architect robust data pipelines, optimize our cloud environment, and ensure our data is secure, reliable, and accessible.

Your primary responsibilities will include :

  • Designing, developing, and deploying scalable ETL / ELT pipelines using Azure Data Factory and PySpark.
  • Architecting and managing our Databricks environment, leveraging Unity Catalog to build a state-of-the-art Lakehouse architecture.
  • Implementing and managing infrastructure on container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes.
  • Developing monitoring and observability solutions using tools like Grafana to ensure system health and performance.
  • Collaborating with data scientists, analysts, and software engineers to understand data needs and deliver effective solutions.
  • Championing best practices in data governance, data quality, and cloud security.

What You'll Bring

We're looking for a seasoned expert with a passion for building great things. You should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and have a strong foundation in data engineering and cloud principles.

Key Qualifications :

  • Proven experience as a Data Engineer, Cloud Architect, or a similar role.
  • Strong proficiency in building data pipelines with Azure Data Factory and processing large-scale data with PySpark.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with the Databricks platform, including a strong understanding of Unity Catalog and the principles of Lakehouse architecture.
  • Solid experience with containerization and orchestration using Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with monitoring and visualization tools, specifically Grafana.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently.
  • Must currently reside in Brazil. Preference will be given to candidates in the greater São Paulo area to facilitate occasional team meetups.

Why You'll Love Working With Us

We believe that our team is our greatest asset, and we invest in our people accordingly. When you join us, you can expect :

  • Competitive Compensation: An attractive salary and benefits package.
  • Remote-First Culture: The flexibility to work from anywhere in Brazil, with the technology and support you need to succeed.
  • Amazing Startup Environment: A vibrant, inclusive, and collaborative culture where your ideas are valued and your impact is real.
  • Growth Opportunities: The chance to grow your skills and career in a rapidly expanding company.
  • Meaningful Work: The opportunity to work on challenging projects that have a direct impact on our business and customers.

If you are a data visionary ready to make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you!

Você quer trabalhar em um lugar que está transformando a educação pública do Brasil? Se imagina em um ambiente colaborativo , inovador e com um propósito que importa ? Quer fazer parte de um time que valoriza a diversidade , promove a inclusão e acredita na potência de cada pessoa?

A Nova Escola é uma organização sem fins lucrativos e a marca mais reconhecida por educadoras e educadores da Educação Básica no Brasil. Nossa missão é fortalecer professores e professoras para transformar a educação pública e garantir que cada estudante desenvolva seu máximo potencial.

Essas parcerias nos ajudam e impulsionam nesse desafio de transformar a educação pública através dos educadores, promovendo ações que os apoiem a desenvolverem suas práticas, terem os melhores recursos e se informarem.

Sobre a área de Dados

A área de Dados da Nova Escola atua para organizar, analisar e disponibilizar dados que apoiem a tomada de decisões em toda a organização, com foco em aprimorar nossos processos e produtos e ampliar nosso impacto na Educação Básica. Nosso time é responsável por todo o ciclo de vida dos dados, desde a coleta e modelagem até a construção de análises, relatórios e dashboards, garantindo que diferentes áreas tenham acesso a informações confiáveis, úteis e acionáveis.

Trabalhamos em parceria com diferentes times, garantindo a qualidade, consistência e acessibilidade dos dados, e promovendo uma cultura orientada por evidências.

SUAS PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES SERÃO:

  • Trabalhar com bases de dados grandes e complexas, realizando a captura, manipulação e análise dessas informações
  • Conduzir todo o ciclo de análise de dados, da definição de requisitos à coleta, processamento, modelagem, visualização e apresentação de resultados
  • Criar e manter dashboards, relatórios e análises que apoiem a tomada de decisões e o acompanhamento dos objetivos estratégicos

  • Colaborar com diferentes áreas como Produto, Tecnologia, UX, Marketing, Conteúdo, Parcerias e Liderança para entender demandas, apoiar a disponibilização de dados, aprimorar análises existentes e contribuir na avaliação de resultados
  • Fazer recomendações baseadas em dados, como análises de comportamento de usuários, apoio na definição de metas organizacionais e OKRs dos squads, além do desdobramento e monitoramento dessas metas
  • Atuar como embaixador(a) da cultura orientada por dados, contribuindo para autonomia dos times e fortalecendo esse valor na Nova Escola

  • Formação ou experiência consolidada em áreas quantitativas, com domínio de conceitos analíticos, estatísticos e computacionais
  • Experiência prática com análise de dados em contextos reais, com atuação em exploração de grandes bases, geração de insights e apoio à tomada de decisão
  • Domínio de SQL avançado, com capacidade de explorar bases complexas e responder questões analíticas de forma eficiente

Conheça a Nova Escola

A Nova Escola é um negócio social de Educação e a marca mais reconhecida por professores de Educação Básica no Brasil

Nossa missão é fortalecer educadores para transformar a Educação pública brasileira e possibilitar que os alunos desenvolvam o máximo do seu potencial.

Desenvolvemos produtos, serviços e conteúdos que valorizam os professores, facilitam seu dia-a-dia e apoiam sua carreira. Nosso principal mantenedor é a Fundação Lemann e realizamos parcerias com diversas organizações como Google.org, Facebook, Fundação Itaú Social, Imaginable Futures, Governo Britânico, secretarias de educação e outras organizações que nos ajudam nesse desafio.

Valorizamos a diversidade no ambiente de trabalho e estamos buscando tornar a Nova Escola ainda mais diversa. As nossas vagas são destinadas a todos!

Trabalhamos com

O Educador no centro: Para nós, a transformação acontece através das professoras e professores de escola pública. Sentimos orgulho das nossas soluções serem baseadas em dados e evidências, desenvolvidas a partir e junto daqueles que vivenciam diariamente a realidade da educação pública brasileira. Estamos unidos com os professores por uma causa comum: oferecer um ensino de qualidade para todos os alunos do nosso país.

Autonomia para ir além: Somos inquietos, dispostos a arriscar, dialogar e reinventar. Criamos novos formatos, melhoramos os existentes, mantendo o foco nos educadores. Assumimos riscos, testamos novas soluções, aprendemos com os erros e medimos nosso impacto. Com essa confiança e autonomia, podemos concentrar nossos esforços no propósito que nos move.

Busca pela Excelência: Nosso time está comprometido a buscar a excelência em tudo que faz para atingir a missão da Nova Escola. Exigimos de nós mesmos um trabalho de qualidade e melhoria contínua. Procuramos, a partir de nossas especialidades, aprender continuamente sobre a Educação Pública.

Juntos e Diversos: Para nós, a diversidade, a inclusão e os conhecimentos multidisciplinares são pilares fundamentais para as nossas práticas, tanto nas ações que desenvolvemos com/para os educadores do Brasil quanto em iniciativas internas. Acreditamos que pessoas com diferentes trajetórias e pontos de vista se complementam e podem compartilhar um mesmo propósito. Pensamos juntos para pensar maior.

Atitude Responsável: Para nós, agir com responsabilidade é uma prática contínua, tanto no trabalho quanto na vida. Gerenciamos pessoas, parceiros e recursos para desenvolver soluções que geram impacto na educação. Mantemos uma atitude ética, respeitosa, acolhedora e proativa para inspirar uma mudança na sociedade. Nossa atuação é suprapartidária e livre de interesses pessoais na sociedade.

Diálogo transparente: Promovemos um ambiente onde todos se sentem à vontade para fazer perguntas e buscar esclarecimentos abertamente. Incentivamos a comunicação direta e transparente e valorizamos o diálogo produtivo. Acreditamos que a coragem para expressar dúvidas e compartilhar ideias fortalece nossa colaboração e aprimora nossos processos.

title: Sr. Engineer - Sensor Debugging/SaO (Remote)
description:
Overview

As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We’re also a mission-driven company. We cultivate a culture that gives every CrowdStriker both the flexibility and autonomy to own their careers. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About the Role:

CrowdStrike Falcon is a two-component security product. One component is the “sensor”, installed on endpoint client systems that observes system activity and recognizes malicious behavior, then provides on-box prevention capability and remote telemetry to the Falcon cloud. The Cloud component aggregates sensor telemetry for each customer’s network and can correlate malicious behavior across multiple machines, presenting our customers’ operations teams with a prioritized summary of the threats detected in their environments.

Join CrowdStrike and become a key leader in building the most innovative endpoint security solution in the world. Our Sensor Platform Team is responsible for building and maintaining the core components of the sensor. Sensor features cross-cut most core OS subsystems such as file system, memory, processes, and networking. Many features are also built in a way that they will have shared components across multiple OS and hardware platforms (e.g. Windows, macOS, Linux).

As a Senior Engineer for the Sustaining and Operations (SaO) team, you will be expected to have ownership, responsibilities, and projects related to ongoing sensor quality. SaO team duties include troubleshooting issues, investigating and proactively responding to incoming sensor telemetry, and championing development projects that will help to improve overall Sensor reliability and supportability. As an expert in this area, you will also be responsible for providing cross-training and best practice to our other sensor engineering teams.

What You\'ll Do

  • Provide technical leadership on the Sensor Platform development team including being generally involved with the strategy and approach for supporting an maintaining enterprise quality next-generation Anti-Virus and Enhanced Detection and Response Security Software.

  • Troubleshooting complex sensor issues, investigate and proactively respond to incoming sensor telemetry, and champion development projects that will help to improve overall sensor reliability and supportability

  • Support sensor product development teams in designing and building high quality sensor software including providing cross-training and best practice

  • Collaborate with multi-functional teams in various locations

What You\'ll Need

  • Strong knowledge and understanding of C++ and Windows Operating System internals

  • Experience working with teams to define and execute on major projects

  • Experience working with python and test frameworks

  • Ability to lead, mentor, communicate, collaborate, partner and work effectively in a distributed team

Bonus Points

  • Strong background in scalable, light-weight and highly performing systems

  • OS system expertise for core concepts and subsystems

  • Familiarity with other common endpoint operating systems including macOS and Linux

  • Familiarity and experience with Agile process

  • Knowledge and expertise in the Security landscape

  • Market leader in compensation and equity awards

This role demands a proactive approach to secure software development and cloud-native defense. You will partner closely with engineering and development squads, and work alongside our Cloud Security and GRC team members to improve Rain’s application and platform security posture.

This position is technically grounded, requiring direct engagement in application-layer matters and security reviews, while also contributing to cloud security automation, awareness initiatives, and secure engineering practices across the SDLC.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with development squads to validate vulnerabilities and provide actionable remediation guidance aligned with business risk.

  • Build and maintain a security issues dashboard to track remediation status and metrics.
  • Provide real-time support in the event of cybersecurity incidents impacting applications or cloud infrastructure (exploited vuln, credential stuffing, web / API attacks).
  • Partner with the Cloud Security team on security automation tasks and monitoring improvements (e.g., Security Hub remediation automations, DLP monitoring, etc.).
  • Conduct proactive research on new threats, vulnerabilities, and attack techniques relevant to Rain’s architecture.
  • Collaborate with the GRC team to develop and deliver internal security awareness initiatives, phishing campaigns , and developer training (e.g., secure coding, API security).
  • Participate in the continuous improvement of AppSec maturity (e.g., aligning with OWASP SAMM, ISO 27001, or SOC 2 frameworks).

Required Qualifications

  • Fluent English , including strong verbal and written skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical mindset .
  • Excellent communication skills to convey security risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • 3–5+ years of experience in application security, penetration testing roles, and / or secure code development, including work with QA teams.
  • Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, and SCA tools (e.g., Semgrep, Burp, Snyk).
  • Deep understanding of web, mobile, and API vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, API Top 10, MITRE CWE).
  • Proven expertise in performing code review or security assessments and writing clear reports.
  • Proficiency in at least one backend language (e.g., Go, Python, Node.js) and understanding of React / React Native front-ends.
  • Familiarity with secure architecture of microservices, event-driven systems, and REST APIs using OAuth2 / OpenID Connect.
  • Experience securing CI / CD pipelines and integrating AppSec tooling into SDLC .
  • Solid knowledge of containerization and Kubernetes security fundamentals .
  • Understanding of cloud security (preferably AWS), including IAM principles, cloud-native service configurations, and network segmentation.
  • Comfortable with Agile development methodologies and working within cross-functional squads.
  • Software supply chain security (e.g., SBOM, artifact signing).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications such as OSCP , OSWE , GWAPT , CPTE , or CSSLP .
  • AWS, GCP, or Azure Security Specialty certification .
  • Familiarity with bug bounty triage and vulnerability management platforms (e.g., DefectDojo).
  • Experience implementing RASP or eBPF runtime protection tools.
  • Exposure to LLM / AI security considerations and secure code generation practices.
  • Familiarity with logging and monitoring tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Datadog, Grafana).

title: Senior Backend Developer ( Ruby / Remote / SaaS )
description:
Ready to own it, build it, and grow it?

About us:

We are Publitas! We’re a remote-first, fast-growing SaaS company helping brands turn static content into digital discovery experiences that drive results.

We’re not about busywork, hierarchy, or hand-holding. We hire sharp minds, trust them fully, and measure success by real results, not noise. If you thrive in autonomy, challenge, and high ownership , you’ll love it here.

This role is for you if you…

  • Get excited by taking ownership and figuring things out proactively.

  • Thrive in a remote, async, fast-paced environment.

  • Are striving to deliver impact, not just running tasks.

  • Think in systems but execute with creativity.

  • Are direct, collaborative, and have a growth mindset

This role is NOT for you if you…

  • Need layers of process or someone to constantly tell you what to do.

  • Prefer “business as usual” over change.

  • Want a team where mediocre is okay.

  • Have never worked remotely and think async means “lonely”

  • Are waiting for permission instead of taking initiative.


The work you’ll do…

  • Collaborating with a cross-functional team to translate customer needs and product vision into new features.

  • Helping us maintain and improve our platform's performance, stability, and scalability.

  • Contributing to our backend architecture and strategy.

  • You will be involved in monitoring and triaging issues & bugs.

  • You will help and mentor less experienced developers and help us build a strong engineering team.

What you’ll bring to the team:

  • You are educated in the field, preferably with a Master's degree, or you have several years of experience working in a well-known and established SaaS company.

  • You have several years of experience building web applications in Ruby on Rails and other technologies and frameworks. Our backend is mostly Ruby on Rails with a bit of Node.js.

  • You can work back from the problem domain towards technical solutions, making technical decisions and breaking problems into manageable chunks on the way.

  • You have experience releasing, maintaining, and scaling a SaaS product on the public cloud. Our product runs on AWS.

  • You're a strong, written and verbal communicator, very fluent, and comfortable with English. You can explain technical concepts and help bring consensus within the team.

  • It’s a bonus if you have experience with our frontend technologies, React and Redux, and can build simple things end-to-end.

  • It is an extra advantage if you have experience with data pipelines and data modeling using technologies like Apache Spark. As well as experience or an affinity with DevOps technologies, such as Infrastructure As Code.

What We Provide to Help You Win…

  • A competitive salary

  • 25 vacation days + your local national holidays

  • A top-tier MacBook and remote-ready gear

  • Monthly wellness budget to invest in your health

  • Co-Working allowance

  • Events, training, or courses that directly and primarily contribute to your work at Publitas

  • Free books on Kindle and Audible

  • Free Publitas Swag (merchandise)

How to apply…

We don’t ask for CVs or cover letters. Why? Because they rarely tell us who you are or what you’re truly great at.

Instead, we ask smart questions and give you a chance to show us what you’d bring to the role.

No fluff. Just real insight into what it’s like to work together.
